source.text: הִנְנִ֤י שֹׁלֵחַ֙ מַלְאָכִ֔י וּפִנָּה־דֶ֖רֶךְ לְפָנָ֑י וּפִתְאֹם֩ יָב֨וֹא אֶל־הֵיכָל֜וֹ הָאָד֣וֹן׀אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֣ם מְבַקְשִׁ֗ים וּמַלְאַ֨ךְ הַבְּרִ֜ית אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֤ם חֲפֵצִים֙ הִנֵּה־בָ֔א אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, I [am] sending my messenger, and he will clear [the] way before me; and suddenly he will come to his temple, the Lord whom you are seeking, and the messenger of the covenant, in whom you delight; look, he is coming, says Yahweh of hosts.

en.L: Look, I am sending {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} messenger, \q and he will clear the way before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; \q and suddenly the Lord whom you are seeking will come to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple, and the messenger of the covenant, in whom you delight; look, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is coming, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts.
en.B: See, I am sending {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} messenger, \q and he will clear the way ahead of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q Then suddenly the Lord you are seeking will come to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple; the messenger of the covenant, whom you desire, is coming, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: Look! I am sending {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} messenger \q to prepare the way for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q Then suddenly the Lord you are looking for will come to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple. The messenger of the covenant, the one you want to see, is coming, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

fr.L: Voici, j’envoie {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} messager, \q et il préparera le chemin devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; \q et soudain viendra dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple le Seigneur que vous cherchez, et le messager de l’alliance, en qui vous prenez plaisir ; voici, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vient, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.B: Voici que j’envoie {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} messager, \q et il préparera le chemin devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q Alors soudain, le Seigneur que vous cherchez entrera dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple ; le messager de l’alliance, que vous désirez, va venir, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Regardez ! J’envoie {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} messager \q pour préparer la route pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q Alors soudain, le Seigneur que vous cherchez viendra dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple. Le messager de l’alliance, celui que vous voulez voir, va venir, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

es.L: He aquí, yo envío a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mensajero, \q y preparará el camino delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}; \q y vendrá de repente a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo el Señor a quien {{plural_you:ustedes buscan|vosotros buscáis}}, y el mensajero del pacto, en quien {{plural_you:se complacen|os complacéis}}; he aquí, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} viene, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos.
es.B: Yo envío a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mensajero, \q y él preparará el camino delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q Entonces vendrá de repente a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo el Señor a quien {{plural_you:ustedes buscan|vosotros buscáis}}; ya viene el mensajero del pacto, a quien {{plural_you:desean|deseáis}}, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: ¡Atención! Voy a enviar a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mensajero \q para que prepare el camino delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q Entonces, de repente, el Señor a quien {{plural_you:ustedes buscan|vosotros buscáis}} vendrá a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo. Ya viene el mensajero del pacto, el que {{plural_you:ustedes desean|vosotros deseáis}} ver, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

vi.L: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sai sứ giả của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q và người sẽ dọn đường trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q và thình lình Chúa mà các ngươi đang tìm kiếm sẽ đến đền thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cùng sứ giả của giao ước mà các ngươi ưa thích; kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang đến, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán.
vi.B: Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sai sứ giả của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q và người sẽ dọn đường trước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Rồi thình lình Chúa mà các ngươi đang tìm kiếm sẽ đến đền thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; sứ giả của giao ước mà các ngươi mong mỏi đang đến, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán.
vi.R: Hãy xem! Ta sai sứ giả của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \q đi dọn đường cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Rồi thình lình Chúa mà các ngươi đang trông đợi sẽ đến đền thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Sứ giả của giao ước, là đấng các ngươi mong được gặp, đang đến, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán.

sw.L: Tazama, ninamtuma mjumbe {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q naye ataiandaa njia mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}; \q na ghafula Bwana mnayemtafuta atakuja hekaluni {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}, naye mjumbe wa agano mnayependezwa naye; tazama, anakuja, \q asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.B: Tazama, ninamtuma mjumbe {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q naye ataiandaa njia mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. \q Kisha ghafula Bwana mnayemtafuta atakuja hekaluni {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}; mjumbe wa agano mnayemtamani anakuja, \q asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.R: Tazama! Ninamtuma mjumbe {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} \q aniandalie njia. \q Kisha ghafula Bwana mnayemtafuta atakuja hekaluni {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}. Mjumbe wa agano, yule mnayetamani kumwona, anakuja, \q anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.

ko.L: 보라, 내가 내 사자를 보낸다. \q 그가 내 앞에서 길을 닦을 것이다. \q 너희가 찾는 주님께서 갑자기 그분의 성전에 오실 것이다. 너희가 기뻐하는 언약의 사자, 보라, 그분께서 오신다. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.B: 보아라, 내가 내 사자를 보낸다. \q 그가 내 앞에서 길을 닦을 것이다. \q 그러면 너희가 찾는 주님께서 갑자기 그분의 성전에 오실 것이다. 너희가 바라는 언약의 사자, 그분께서 오신다. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 보아라! 내가 내 심부름꾼을 보내어 \q 나를 맞을 길을 준비하게 하겠다. \q 그러면 너희가 찾는 주님께서 갑자기 그분의 성전에 오실 것이다. 너희가 보고 싶어 하는 언약을 전하는 사자, 그분께서 오신다. \q 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: Eis que eu envio o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} mensageiro, \q que preparará o caminho diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}; \q e de repente virá ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} templo o Senhor a quem vocês buscam, e o mensageiro da aliança, de quem vocês se agradam; eis que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vem, \q diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.B: Vejam, eu estou enviando o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} mensageiro, \q que preparará o caminho à {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} frente. \q Então, de repente, o Senhor que vocês buscam virá ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} templo; o mensageiro da aliança, que vocês desejam, está vindo, \q diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.R: Olhem! Eu vou enviar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} mensageiro \q para preparar o caminho para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. \q Então, de repente, o Senhor que vocês estão procurando virá ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} templo. O mensageiro da aliança, aquele que vocês querem ver, está vindo, \q diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.

am.L: እነሆ፣ መልእክተኛዬን እልካለሁ፤ \q እርሱም በፊቴ መንገድን ያዘጋጃል፤ \q የምትሹትም ጌታ በድንገት ወደ መቅደሱ ይመጣል፤ ደስ የምትሰኙበትም የቃል ኪዳኑ መልእክተኛ፤ እነሆ፣ ይመጣል፤ \q ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት።
am.B: መልእክተኛዬን እልካለሁ፤ \q እርሱም ከእኔ አስቀድሞ መንገድን ያዘጋጃል። \q ከዚያም የምትፈልጉት ጌታ በድንገት ወደ ቤተ መቅደሱ ይመጣል፤ የምትናፍቁት የቃል ኪዳኑ መልእክተኛ ይመጣል፣ \q ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: ተመልከቱ! መልእክተኛዬን እልካለሁ፤ \q እርሱም መንገዱን ያዘጋጅልኛል። \q ከዚያም የምትፈልጉት ጌታ በድንገት ወደ ቤተ መቅደሱ ይመጣል። ልታዩት የምትፈልጉት የቃል ኪዳኑ መልእክተኛ ይመጣል፣ \q ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: देखो, मैं अपना संदेशवाहक भेज रहा हूँ, \q और वह मेरे आगे मार्ग तैयार करेगा; \q और प्रभु, जिन्हें तुम ढूँढ़ते हो, अचानक अपने मंदिर में आएँगे, और वाचा का संदेशवाहक, जिनसे तुम प्रसन्न हो; देखो, वे आ रहे हैं, \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।
hi.B: देखो, मैं अपने संदेशवाहक को भेज रहा हूँ, \q और वह मेरे आगे-आगे रास्ता तैयार करेगा। \q तब प्रभु, जिन्हें तुम ढूँढ़ रहे हो, अचानक अपने मंदिर में आएँगे; वाचा का संदेशवाहक, जिनकी तुम्हें चाह है, आ रहे हैं, \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।
hi.R: देखो! मैं अपने संदेशवाहक को भेज रहा हूँ \q कि वह मेरे लिए रास्ता तैयार करे। \q तब प्रभु, जिन्हें तुम खोज रहे हो, अचानक अपने मंदिर में आएँगे। वाचा का संदेशवाहक, जिन्हें तुम देखना चाहते हो, आ रहे हैं, \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: Вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посылаю {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} вестника, \q и он приготовит путь передо {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}}; \q и внезапно придёт в свой храм Господь, которого вы ищете, и вестник завета, которого вы желаете; вот, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} идёт, \q — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф.
ru.B: Вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посылаю {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} вестника, \q и он приготовит путь передо {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}}. \q Тогда внезапно придёт в свой храм Господь, которого вы ищете; вестник завета, которого вы желаете, идёт, \q — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф.
ru.R: Смотрите! Я посылаю {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} вестника, \q чтобы он приготовил путь для {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}. \q Тогда внезапно придёт в свой храм Господь, которого вы ищете. Вестник завета, которого вы хотите увидеть, идёт, \q — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств.

ja.L: 見なさい、わたしはわたしの使者を遣わす。 \q その者は、わたしの前に道を整える。 \q あなたがたが求めている主は、突然、その神殿に来る。あなたがたが喜びとしている契約の使者、見なさい、その方が来る、 \q と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。
ja.B: 見なさい、わたしはわたしの使者を遣わす。 \q その者は、わたしに先立って道を整える。 \q あなたがたが求めている主は、突然、その神殿に来る。あなたがたが待ち望んでいる契約の使者が、来る、 \q と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。
ja.R: 見なさい！わたしは、わたしの使いを送る。 \q その使いが、わたしのために道を準備する。 \q そして、あなたたちが探し求めている主が、突然、その神殿に来る。あなたたちが会いたいと願っている契約の使いが、やって来る、 \q と天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。

uk.L: Ось {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посилаю свого вісника, \q і він приготує дорогу переді {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}}; \q і раптово прийде до свого храму Господь, якого ви шукаєте, і вісник завіту, якого ви бажаєте; ось {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} іде, \q говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот.
uk.B: Ось {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посилаю свого вісника, \q і він приготує дорогу переді {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}}. \q Тоді раптово прийде до свого храму Господь, якого ви шукаєте; вісник завіту, якого ви прагнете, уже йде, \q говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ.
uk.R: Дивіться! Я посилаю свого вісника, \q щоб він приготував дорогу для {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}. \q Тоді раптово Господь, якого ви шукаєте, прийде до свого храму. Вісник завіту, якого ви хочете побачити, уже йде, \q каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель.

decisions.choice: my messenger: one sent ahead to prepare for the LORD's coming
decisions.reason: "My messenger" (mal'akhi) is the same as the prophet's name (1:1). Here he is one the LORD will send to prepare the way before him, as a herald goes ahead of a king. 3:23 names him: "Elijah the prophet". |

decisions.choice: he will clear the way before me: the words of Isaiah 40:3
decisions.reason: The verb and noun are the same as in Isaiah 40:3, "In the wilderness clear the way of the LORD". The road is cleared for the LORD himself to come. |

decisions.choice: quoted in Mark 1:2 and Matthew 11:10
decisions.reason: Mark 1:2, joining this verse to Isaiah 40:3, and Jesus in Matthew 11:10 (also Luke 7:27) apply the promise to John the Baptist. Their Greek wording differs from the Hebrew: "I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way", so that "before me" becomes "before you". The verse here is translated from the Hebrew. |

decisions.choice: the Lord who comes to his temple, and the messenger of the covenant
alternatives: the messenger of the covenant as a second figure, distinct from the Lord
decisions.reason: "The Lord" (ha'adon) coming to "his temple" is God himself, who says in verse 5, "I will draw near to you for judgment". This answers the question of 2:17, "Where is the God of justice?" "The messenger of the covenant" is set in parallel with the Lord, and may be the same figure, God coming in person as the angel of the LORD came in Israel's early history (Exodus 23:20-23), or a messenger who enforces the covenant. The text does not settle it. Both titles are lowercase as descriptions. Christians have read the coming Lord as Jesus, coming to the temple after John prepared his way.

decisions.choice: whom you are seeking, in whom you delight: the God the people say they want
decisions.reason: The people asked for the God of justice (2:17). They will get what they asked for, but his coming will be a day of judgment for them too (verse 2). |

decisions.choice: my messenger, the messenger of the covenant, lowercase at every level; clear the way (L, B)
decisions.reason: Both messengers are lowercase at every level, as set for Malachi. "Clear the way" follows Isaiah 40:3 at Literal; Readable says "prepare the way". The pronouns "his temple" and "he is coming" refer to the coming Lord, and take the deity_pronoun setting; "he will clear the way" refers to the messenger and does not. |

decisions.choice: "j'envoie mon messager", lowercase, at every level; "il préparera le chemin devant moi" (L, B), "préparer la route pour moi" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet: the published Mark 1:2 and Matthew 11:10 share these words, and "préparer le chemin" is the verb of Isaiah 40:3, which Malachi echoes; "messager" stays lowercase, as "le messager de l'alliance".

decisions.choice: "preparará el camino" / "prepare el camino"
decisions.reason: The English says "clear the way" at L and B; Spanish keeps "preparar el camino", the words of Matthew 11:10, Mark 1:2 and Luke 7:27 in Spanish, because the Hebrew allows it and the quotation can then be seen. The Gospels' Greek adds "before your face", which the Hebrew does not have.

decisions.choice: "mi mensajero", "el mensajero del pacto", lowercase
decisions.reason: Both messengers are lowercase, as in the English; "mi" takes a deity_pronoun span as God's own word.

decisions.choice: "sứ giả của Ta", lowercase, and "dọn đường", as Mark 1:2 and Matthew 11:10; "Chúa" (ha'adon) capitalised with no span; "sứ giả của giao ước", lowercase
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording, shared with the Gospels so the quotation is visible; the Gospels add "before you" (Con) from the Greek. Mal'akhi is also the prophet's name (1:1).

decisions.choice: "Tazama, ninamtuma mjumbe wangu, naye ataiandaa njia mbele yangu"; "mjumbe" and "mjumbe wa agano" lowercase
decisions.reason: As the term sheet: the verbs of the published Mark 1:2 and Matthew 11:10, which quote this verse from the Greek ("mbele ya uso wako" there, "mbele yangu" here, as the Hebrew). "Mjumbe" echoes the book's name, Malaki, "my messenger".

decisions.choice: "anakuja", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English "he" is in the Swahili verb prefix, which takes no span; the span falls on the free possessive "mwake".

decisions.choice: "내 사자" (L, B), "내 심부름꾼" (R); "언약의 사자" (L, B), "언약을 전하는 사자" (R); no -시- for "my messenger"
decisions.reason: As the term sheet; Mark 1:2 and Matthew 11:10 quote the first line with the same words ("내 사자", R "내 심부름꾼"), though they say "before you" from the Greek where the Hebrew has "before me". "My messenger" is the same word as the book's name, Malachi.

decisions.choice: "주님께서 … 오실 것이다" and "그분께서 오신다" with -시-
decisions.reason: The English gives the Lord who comes to his temple, and the one who is coming, deity spans; Korean gives them the honorific, as the term sheet asks for "He is coming", even though God himself is speaking.

decisions.choice: o meu mensageiro, que preparará o caminho diante de mim (L), à minha frente (B), para mim (R)
decisions.reason: Mark 1:2 and Matthew 11:10 quote this verse (m3), so Portuguese keeps their words where the Hebrew says the same: "envio o meu mensageiro" and "preparará o caminho" (also the verb of Isaiah 40:3 in Portuguese, m2). The Gospels follow the Greek, "before your face ... your way"; Malachi follows the Hebrew, where the way is prepared before the LORD himself, so "diante de mim" (L), "à minha frente" (B), "para mim" (R). The messenger's pronoun takes no deity_pronoun setting; the LORD's "mim" and "minha" do.

decisions.choice: o Senhor; o mensageiro da aliança, lowercase; seu templo, ele vem with the deity_pronoun setting
decisions.reason: Ha'adon is "o Senhor", the capital Portuguese gives Adonai and God's titles; "o mensageiro da aliança" stays lowercase, as the English, since the text does not settle who he is (m4), and "mensageiro" keeps the link with "o meu mensageiro" and the prophet's name. The pronouns for the coming Lord carry the setting, as in the English.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Malachi 3
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns and verb forms for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: Matthew 11:10, Mark 1:2 and Luke 7:27: "መልእክተኛዬን … እልካለሁ" and "እርሱም … መንገድ … ያዘጋጃል", as the Amharic Gospels; "before me" "በፊቴ" (L), "ከእኔ አስቀድሞ" (B), "ያዘጋጅልኛል" (R), from the Hebrew
alternatives: "በፊትህ … መንገድህን" (before your face, your way), as the Gospels
decisions.reason: The Gospels apply the verse to John the Baptist in Greek that differs from the Hebrew: they read "before your face" and "your way", where the Hebrew has "before me" (meaning decision m3). The verse is drafted fresh from the Hebrew, keeping the Gospels' words where both say the same thing ("my messenger", "I send", "prepare the way"). "ያዘጋጃል" is also the verb of Isaiah 40:3 on main ("መንገድ አዘጋጁ"), which the Hebrew echoes (meaning decision m2). The Lord (ha'adon) is "ጌታ"; the messenger of the covenant "የቃል ኪዳኑ መልእክተኛ".

decisions.choice: "посилаю свого вісника" and "приготує дорогу", the words of the Ukrainian Matthew 11:10 and Mark 1:2, drafted from the Hebrew "before me"
decisions.reason: The Gospels quote this verse in a changed form ("before you"); where the Hebrew and the Gospels agree, the Ukrainian uses the same words, so the reader hears the quotation.

decisions.choice: मैं अपना संदेशवाहक भेज रहा हूँ (L), अपने संदेशवाहक को भेज रहा हूँ (B, R); मेरे आगे मार्ग तैयार करेगा (L), मेरे आगे-आगे रास्ता तैयार करेगा (B), मेरे लिए रास्ता तैयार करे (R)
decisions.reason: Matthew 11:10, Mark 1:2 and Luke 7:27 quote this line in a different form: "I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way", addressed to the one who comes. The Hebrew says "before me", and the LORD speaks to the people with तुम, so Hindi translates the Hebrew and keeps the Gospels' words where they agree: संदेशवाहक, भेज रहा हूँ, आगे-आगे (B) and रास्ता तैयार करना (B, R), level by level. "Clear the way" is तैयार करना, as in Isaiah 40:3 (m2).

decisions.choice: प्रभु without the span; संदेशवाहक for both messengers; honorific आएँगे, अपने, वे आ रहे हैं
decisions.reason: "The Lord" here is ha'adon, a title, so प्रभु stands without the divine_name setting. Both messengers are संदेशवाहक, as the name Malachi means "my messenger" (1:1). The Lord who comes to his temple and the messenger of the covenant take honorific forms (m4), as God does; the first messenger, who prepares the way, is plain वह.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun spans have no Hindi counterpart; God speaking says मैं and मेरा, and God spoken of takes the honorific plural.

decisions.choice: "Вот, Я посылаю Моего вестника ... приготовит путь передо Мной" (L, B); "Я посылаю Моего вестника ... приготовил путь для Меня" (R)
alternatives: "перед Твоим лицом ... Твой путь перед Тобой", as the Gospels
decisions.reason: Matthew 11:10, Mark 1:2 and Luke 7:27 quote the line in a different form ("before your face ... your way before you"). This is translated from the Hebrew ("before me"), keeping the Gospels' Russian words where they agree: "Вот, Я посылаю Моего вестника" and "приготовит путь" (the verb of Isaiah 40:3 in Russian), level by level.

decisions.choice: "вестник" lowercase for both messengers; "в свой храм" with no span
decisions.reason: Both messengers are lowercase at every level, as in the English; "his temple" is the reflexive "свой" in Russian, which takes no deity_pronoun span. "Господь" is Adonai.

decisions.choice: mal'akhi "わたしの使者" (L, B), "わたしの使い" (R), and pinnah derekh "道を整える" (L, B), "道を準備する" (R), as the Japanese of Mark 1:2 and Matthew 11:10 / Luke 7:27 per level; drafted from the Hebrew, so lefanai stays "わたしの前に" / "わたしに先立って" (the Gospels have "before you").
decisions.reason: The NT quotations' wording is kept where the Hebrew agrees and left where it differs.

decisions.choice: ha'adon "主" with no span; mal'akh habberit "契約の使者" (L, B), "契約の使い" (R); inside the LORD's own words the coming Lord takes no respect form ("来る", "その方").
decisions.reason: Who the Lord and the messenger of the covenant are is left open (meaning decision, footnote); the plain verb keeps the rule for God's own speech.

source.text: וּמִ֤י מְכַלְכֵּל֙ אֶת־י֣וֹם בּוֹא֔וֹ וּמִ֥י הָעֹמֵ֖ד בְּהֵרָֽאוֹת֑וֹ כִּֽי־הוּא֙ כְּאֵ֣שׁ מְצָרֵ֔ף וּכְבֹרִ֖ית מְכַבְּסִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And who can endure the day of his coming, and who [is] the one standing when he appears? For he [is] like a refiner's fire and like launderers' soap.

en.L: But who can endure the day of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} coming, \q and who is the one who stands when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appears? \q For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] like the fire of a refiner \q and like the soap of launderers.
en.B: But who can bear the day of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} coming? \q Who can hold their ground when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appears? \q For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be like a refiner's fire \q and like the soap of those who wash clothes.
en.R: But who will be able to live through the day when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} comes? \q Who will be able to stand when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appears? \q He will be like a fire that makes metal pure, \q like strong soap that makes clothes clean.

fr.L: Mais qui supportera le jour de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} venue, \q et qui [est] celui qui tiendra debout quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} paraîtra ? \q Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [est] comme le feu du fondeur \q et comme la soude des blanchisseurs.
fr.B: Mais qui pourra supporter le jour de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} venue ? \q Qui tiendra bon quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} paraîtra ? \q Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sera comme le feu du fondeur \q et comme le savon de ceux qui lavent le linge.
fr.R: Mais qui pourra survivre au jour où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} viendra ? \q Qui pourra rester debout quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} apparaîtra ? \q Il sera comme un feu qui rend le métal pur, \q comme un savon puissant qui rend les vêtements propres.

es.L: ¿Pero quién podrá soportar el día de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} venida, \q y quién [es] el que podrá mantenerse en pie cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} aparezca? \q Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] como fuego de fundidor \q y como jabón de lavanderos.
es.B: Pero ¿quién podrá soportar el día de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} venida? \q ¿Quién podrá mantenerse firme cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} aparezca? \q Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} será como fuego de fundidor \q y como el jabón de los que lavan la ropa.
es.R: Pero ¿quién podrá sobrevivir el día en que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} venga? \q ¿Quién podrá quedar en pie cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} aparezca? \q Él será como el fuego que purifica el metal, \q como un jabón fuerte que deja limpia la ropa.

vi.L: Nhưng ai chịu nổi ngày {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến, \q và ai là người đứng vững khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hiện ra? \q Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như lửa của thợ luyện kim \q và như xà phòng của thợ giặt.
vi.B: Nhưng ai chịu nổi ngày {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến? \q Ai đứng vững được khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hiện ra? \q Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ như lửa của thợ luyện kim \q và như xà phòng của người giặt đồ.
vi.R: Nhưng ai có thể sống sót qua ngày {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến? \q Ai có thể đứng vững khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hiện ra? \q Ngài sẽ như ngọn lửa luyện kim loại cho tinh ròng, \q như xà phòng mạnh giặt sạch quần áo.

sw.L: Lakini ni nani awezaye kustahimili siku ya kuja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, \q na ni nani atakayesimama atakapoonekana? \q Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ni] kama moto wa msafishaji wa madini \q na kama sabuni ya wafua nguo.
sw.B: Lakini ni nani atakayeweza kuistahimili siku ya kuja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}? \q Ni nani atakayeweza kusimama imara atakapotokea? \q Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atakuwa kama moto wa msafishaji wa madini \q na kama sabuni ya wale wanaofua nguo.
sw.R: Lakini ni nani atakayeweza kuvumilia siku atakapokuja? \q Ni nani atakayeweza kusimama atakapotokea? \q Atakuwa kama moto unaoyeyusha chuma na kukisafisha, \q kama sabuni kali inayofanya nguo kuwa safi.

ko.L: 그러나 그분께서 오시는 날을 누가 견디며, \q 그분께서 나타나실 때에 누가 설 수 있겠느냐? \q 그분은 금속을 녹이는 사람의 불 같고, \q 빨래하는 사람의 잿물 같으실 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 그분께서 오시는 날을 누가 견딜 수 있겠느냐? \q 그분께서 나타나실 때에 누가 버티고 설 수 있겠느냐? \q 그분은 금속을 정련하는 불과 같고, \q 빨래하는 사람의 독한 비누와 같으실 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 그분께서 오시는 날에 누가 살아남을 수 있겠느냐? \q 그분께서 나타나실 때에 누가 설 수 있겠느냐? \q 그분은 쇠붙이를 깨끗하게 하는 불과 같으실 것이다. \q 옷을 깨끗하게 하는 독한 비누와 같으실 것이다.

pt.L: Mas quem pode suportar o dia da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} vinda? \q E quem é o que fica de pé quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} aparece? \q Pois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [é] como o fogo do refinador \q e como o sabão dos lavandeiros.
pt.B: Mas quem poderá suportar o dia da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} vinda? \q Quem conseguirá se manter de pé quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} aparecer? \q Pois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} será como o fogo do refinador \q e como o sabão dos que lavam roupa.
pt.R: Mas quem vai conseguir sobreviver ao dia em que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vier? \q Quem vai conseguir ficar de pé quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} aparecer? \q Ele será como o fogo que deixa o metal puro, \q como um sabão forte que deixa a roupa limpa.

am.L: ነገር ግን የመምጣቱን ቀን ማን ሊቋቋመው ይችላል? \q በሚገለጥበትስ ጊዜ የሚቆም ማን ነው? \q እርሱ እንደ አንጣሪ እሳት፣ \q እንደ ልብስ አጣቢዎችም ሳሙና [ነው]ና።
am.B: ነገር ግን የመምጣቱን ቀን ማን ሊቋቋመው ይችላል? \q በሚገለጥበትስ ጊዜ ጸንቶ ሊቆም የሚችል ማን ነው? \q እርሱ እንደ አንጣሪ እሳት፣ \q እንደ ልብስ አጣቢዎችም ሳሙና ይሆናልና።
am.R: ነገር ግን እርሱ የሚመጣበትን ቀን ማን በሕይወት ሊያልፈው ይችላል? \q በሚገለጥበት ጊዜ ማን ሊቆም ይችላል? \q እርሱ ብረትን እንደሚያጠራ እሳት፣ \q ልብስን እንደሚያነጻ ጠንካራ ሳሙና ይሆናል።

hi.L: पर उनके आने के दिन को कौन सह सकेगा, \q और जब वे प्रकट होंगे, तब कौन खड़ा रह सकेगा? \q क्योंकि वे सुनार की आग के समान \q और धोबियों के साबुन के समान [हैं]।
hi.B: पर उनके आने के दिन को कौन सह सकेगा? \q जब वे प्रकट होंगे, तब कौन टिक सकेगा? \q क्योंकि वे सुनार की आग के समान \q और कपड़े धोनेवालों के साबुन के समान होंगे।
hi.R: पर जिस दिन वे आएँगे, उस दिन कौन जीवित बच पाएगा? \q जब वे प्रकट होंगे, तब कौन खड़ा रह पाएगा? \q वे उस आग के समान होंगे जो धातु को शुद्ध करती है, \q उस तेज़ साबुन के समान जो कपड़ों को साफ़ करता है।

ru.L: Но кто вынесет день {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} прихода, \q и кто устоит, когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} явится? \q Ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} — как огонь плавильщика \q и как щёлок прачек.
ru.B: Но кто вынесет день {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} прихода? \q Кто устоит, когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} явится? \q Ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} будет как огонь плавильщика \q и как щёлок тех, кто стирает одежду.
ru.R: Но кто сможет пережить тот день, когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} придёт? \q Кто сможет устоять, когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} появится? \q Он будет как огонь, который очищает металл, \q как крепкое мыло, которое отбеливает одежду.

ja.L: しかし、その方が来られる日に、だれが耐えられようか？ \q その方が姿を現されるとき、だれが立っていられようか？ \q まことに、その方は精錬する者の火のよう、 \q 布をさらす者たちの灰汁のようである。
ja.B: しかし、その方が来られる日に、だれが耐えられようか？ \q その方が姿を現されるとき、だれが立っていられようか？ \q その方は、精錬する者の火のよう、 \q 布を洗う者の灰汁のようだからだ。
ja.R: しかし、その方が来られる日を、だれが生き延びられるだろうか？ \q その方が姿を現されるとき、だれが立っていられるだろうか？ \q その方は、金属を純粋にする火のようだ。 \q 服をきれいにする強いせっけんのようだ。

uk.L: Та хто витримає день {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} приходу, \q і хто встоїть, коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зʼявиться? \q Бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} — як вогонь плавильника \q і як мило пральників.
uk.B: Та хто витримає день {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} приходу? \q Хто встоїть, коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зʼявиться? \q Бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} буде як вогонь плавильника \q і як мило тих, хто пере одяг.
uk.R: Та хто зможе пережити день, коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} прийде? \q Хто зможе встояти, коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зʼявиться? \q Він буде як вогонь, що очищає метал, \q як міцне мило, що відбілює одяг.

decisions.choice: who can endure the day of his coming?: as in Joel 2:11
decisions.reason: Joel 2:11 asks of the day of the LORD, "who can endure it?" The people longed for God to come and judge (2:17), but none of them can face him unchanged. |

decisions.choice: a refiner's fire, launderers' soap: fire that melts out impurities, lye that bleaches cloth
decisions.reason: Silver and gold were melted in a furnace so that the dross could be skimmed off. Launderers, who cleaned and bleached new cloth, used a strong soap made from the ashes of plants (Jeremiah 2:22). Both pictures are of cleansing that is painful but makes pure. |

decisions.choice: a fire that makes metal pure (R), strong soap that makes clothes clean (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what refiners and launderers did. |

decisions.choice: "fuego de fundidor" (L, B); "el fuego que purifica el metal" (R)
decisions.reason: The refiner melts out impurities; R says what he does, as the English R does.

decisions.choice: "moto wa msafishaji wa madini", "sabuni ya wafua nguo"
decisions.reason: Drafted from the gloss and kept apart from the familiar Union Version wording of this line, as the term sheet asks for Malachi 3.

decisions.choice: quem pode suportar (L), quem poderá suportar (B), quem vai conseguir sobreviver (R)
decisions.reason: The question echoes Joel 2:11 (m1), so each level uses the verb Joel's Portuguese has there: "suportar" at Literal and Balanced, "sobreviver" at Readable.

decisions.choice: who can endure "ማን ሊቋቋመው ይችላል?" (L, B), as Joel 2:11 on main; refiner "አንጣሪ" (from "አነጠረ", Isaiah 48:10); launderers' soap "የልብስ አጣቢዎች ሳሙና", as Jeremiah 2:22
decisions.reason: The question echoes Joel 2:11 (meaning decision m1), so it keeps Joel's Amharic words.

decisions.choice: सुनार की आग; धोबियों का साबुन (L), कपड़े धोनेवालों का साबुन (B)
decisions.reason: The refiner melts the dross out of silver and gold, as a सुनार does; the launderer's soap is lye that bleaches cloth (m2). Readable says what each does, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "кто вынесет день" (L, B); "кто сможет пережить" (R)
decisions.reason: The question echoes Joel 2:11 (m1), so it takes Joel's verbs: "вынесет" (L, B), "сможет пережить" (R).

decisions.choice: 'esh metsaref "精錬する者の火" (L, B), "金属を純粋にする火" (R); borit mekhabbesim "布をさらす者たちの灰汁" (L), "布を洗う者の灰汁" (B), "強いせっけん" (R); the coming one in the prophet's words takes light respect forms ("来られる", "姿を現される"); "だれが耐えられようか" as Joel 2:11.
decisions.reason: R explains the crafts as the English R; Joel's wording for the shared question.

source.text: וְיָשַׁ֨ב מְצָרֵ֤ף וּמְטַהֵר֙ כֶּ֔סֶף וְטִהַ֤ר אֶת־בְּנֵֽי־לֵוִי֙ וְזִקַּ֣ק אֹתָ֔ם כַּזָּהָ֖ב וְכַכָּ֑סֶף וְהָיוּ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה מַגִּישֵׁ֥י מִנְחָ֖ה בִּצְדָקָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will sit refining and purifying silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi and refine them like gold and like silver; and they will be to Yahweh presenting an offering in righteousness.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will sit refining and purifying silver, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will cleanse the sons of Levi and refine them \q like gold and like silver; \q and they will belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q presenting an offering in righteousness.
en.B: He will sit like one who refines and purifies silver; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will purify the descendants of Levi and refine them \q like gold and silver, \q so that they will belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q and bring offerings in righteousness.
en.R: He will sit like a worker who melts silver to make it pure. \q He will make the priests from the tribe of Levi pure, \q as gold and silver are made pure. \q Then they will bring offerings to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q in the right way.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} siégera, épurant et purifiant l’argent, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} purifiera les fils de Lévi et les épurera \q comme l’or et comme l’argent ; \q et ils seront {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, \q présentant une offrande dans la justice.
fr.B: Il {{deity_pronoun:s’|S’}}assiéra comme celui qui épure et purifie l’argent ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} purifiera les descendants de Lévi et les épurera \q comme l’or et l’argent, \q pour qu’ils appartiennent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} \q et présentent des offrandes selon la justice.
fr.R: Il {{deity_pronoun:s’|S’}}assiéra comme un ouvrier qui fait fondre l’argent pour le rendre pur. \q Il rendra purs les prêtres de la tribu de Lévi, \q comme on rend pur l’or et l’argent. \q Alors ils apporteront des offrandes {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} \q de la bonne manière.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se sentará a refinar y purificar la plata, \q y purificará a los hijos de Leví y los refinará \q como el oro y como la plata; \q y serán {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q presentando ofrenda en justicia.
es.B: Se sentará como el que refina y purifica la plata; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} purificará a los descendientes de Leví y los refinará \q como al oro y a la plata, \q para que pertenezcan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} \q y presenten ofrendas en justicia.
es.R: Se sentará como un obrero que funde la plata para purificarla. \q Purificará a los sacerdotes de la tribu de Leví, \q como se purifican el oro y la plata. \q Entonces ellos le traerán ofrendas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} \q de la manera correcta.

vi.L: Ngài sẽ ngồi như người luyện và tinh lọc bạc, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ thanh tẩy các con trai Lê-vi và luyện họ \q như vàng và như bạc; \q và họ sẽ thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q dâng lễ vật trong sự công chính.
vi.B: Ngài sẽ ngồi như người luyện và tinh lọc bạc; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ thanh tẩy dòng dõi Lê-vi và luyện họ \q như luyện vàng và bạc, \q để họ thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} \q và dâng lễ vật trong sự công chính.
vi.R: Ngài sẽ ngồi như người thợ nấu chảy bạc để làm cho bạc tinh ròng. \q Ngài sẽ làm cho các thầy tế lễ thuộc chi tộc Lê-vi được tinh sạch, \q như vàng và bạc được luyện cho tinh ròng. \q Bấy giờ họ sẽ dâng lễ vật lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} \q một cách đúng đắn.

sw.L: Naye ataketi akiyeyusha na kuitakasa fedha, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atawasafisha wana wa Lawi na kuwayeyusha \q kama dhahabu na kama fedha; \q nao watakuwa wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q wakileta sadaka katika haki.
sw.B: Ataketi kama mtu anayeyeyusha fedha na kuisafisha; \q atawasafisha wazao wa Lawi na kuwapitisha motoni \q kama dhahabu na fedha, \q ili wawe mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} \q na walete sadaka kwa haki.
sw.R: Ataketi kama fundi anayeyeyusha fedha ili kuifanya safi. \q Atawafanya safi makuhani wa kabila la Lawi, \q kama dhahabu na fedha zinavyofanywa safi. \q Ndipo watamletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka \q kwa njia iliyo sawa.

ko.L: 그분께서 은을 녹여 깨끗하게 하는 사람처럼 앉으셔서, \q 레위 자손을 깨끗하게 하시고 \q 금과 은처럼 그들을 정련하실 것이다. \q 그러면 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 속하여 \q 의로 예물을 바칠 것이다.
ko.B: 그분은 은을 녹여 깨끗하게 하는 사람처럼 앉으셔서, \q 레위의 자손을 깨끗하게 하시고, \q 금과 은처럼 그들을 정련하실 것이다. \q 그러면 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 속하여 \q 의로운 마음으로 예물을 바칠 것이다.
ko.R: 그분은 은을 녹여 깨끗하게 하는 일꾼처럼 앉으실 것이다. \q 그분은 레위 지파의 제사장들을 깨끗하게 하실 것이다. \q 금과 은을 깨끗하게 하듯 하실 것이다. \q 그러면 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 \q 올바르게 예물을 바칠 것이다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se assentará refinando e purificando a prata, \q e purificará os filhos de Levi e os refinará \q como o ouro e como a prata; \q e eles serão {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q apresentando uma oferta com retidão.
pt.B: Ele se assentará como quem refina e purifica a prata; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} purificará os descendentes de Levi e os refinará \q como ouro e prata, \q para que pertençam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} \q e tragam ofertas com retidão.
pt.R: Ele se sentará como um trabalhador que derrete a prata para deixá-la pura. \q Ele vai purificar os sacerdotes da tribo de Levi, \q como se purificam o ouro e a prata. \q Então eles vão trazer ofertas {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} \q do jeito certo.

am.L: እርሱም ብርን እንደሚያነጥርና እንደሚያጠራ ይቀመጣል፤ \q የሌዊንም ልጆች ያነጻቸዋል፤ ያነጥራቸዋልም \q እንደ ወርቅና እንደ ብር፤ \q {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}}ም ይሆናሉ፤ \q በጽድቅ መባን የሚያቀርቡ [ሆነው]።
am.B: ብርን እንደሚያነጥርና እንደሚያጠራ ሰው ይቀመጣል፤ \q የሌዊን ዘሮች ያነጻቸዋል፤ ያነጥራቸዋልም \q እንደ ወርቅና እንደ ብር፤ \q በዚህም {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ይሆናሉ፤ \q በጽድቅም መባ ያቀርባሉ።
am.R: ብርን አቅልጦ እንደሚያነጥር ሠራተኛ ይቀመጣል። \q ከሌዊ ነገድ የሆኑትን ካህናት ያነጻቸዋል፤ \q ወርቅና ብር እንደሚጠሩ። \q ከዚያም መባቸውን {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} \q በትክክለኛው መንገድ ያቀርባሉ።

hi.L: और वे चाँदी को पिघलानेवाले और शुद्ध करनेवाले के समान बैठेंगे, \q और वे लेवी के पुत्रों को शुद्ध करेंगे और उन्हें निखारेंगे \q सोने और चाँदी के समान; \q और वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के होंगे, \q धार्मिकता से भेंट चढ़ानेवाले।
hi.B: वे चाँदी को पिघलानेवाले और शुद्ध करनेवाले के समान बैठेंगे; \q वे लेवी के वंशजों को शुद्ध करेंगे और उन्हें निखारेंगे \q सोने और चाँदी के समान, \q ताकि वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के हों \q और धार्मिकता से भेंटें चढ़ाएँ।
hi.R: वे उस कारीगर के समान बैठेंगे जो चाँदी को पिघलाकर शुद्ध करता है। \q वे लेवी के गोत्र के याजकों को शुद्ध करेंगे, \q जैसे सोना और चाँदी शुद्ध किए जाते हैं। \q तब वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए भेंटें लाएँगे \q और सही रीति से लाएँगे।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сядет, переплавляя и очищая серебро, \q и очистит сынов Левия и переплавит их, \q как золото и как серебро; \q и они будут для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} \q приносящими приношение в праведности.
ru.B: Он сядет, как тот, кто переплавляет и очищает серебро; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} очистит потомков Левия и переплавит их, \q как золото и серебро, \q чтобы они принадлежали {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} \q и приносили приношения в праведности.
ru.R: Он сядет, как мастер, который плавит серебро, чтобы очистить его. \q Он очистит священников из колена Левия, \q как очищают золото и серебро. \q Тогда они будут приносить приношения {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} \q так, как надо.

ja.L: その方は、銀を精錬し清める者として座られ、 \q レビの子らを清め、彼らを精錬される。 \q 金のように、銀のように。 \q そして彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のものとなり、 \q 義のうちにささげ物をささげる者となる。
ja.B: その方は、銀を精錬して清める者のように座られる。 \q その方はレビの子孫を清め、 \q 金や銀のように彼らを精錬される。 \q こうして彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のものとなり、 \q 義をもってささげ物をささげるようになる。
ja.R: その方は、銀を溶かして純粋にする職人のように座られる。 \q その方は、レビの部族の祭司たちを清くされる。 \q 金や銀が清められるように。 \q そのとき、彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にささげ物を持って来る。 \q 正しいやり方で。

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} сяде, переплавляючи й очищаючи срібло, \q і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} очистить синів Левія і переплавить їх, \q як золото і як срібло; \q і вони належатимуть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, \q приносячи жертву в праведності.
uk.B: Він сяде, як той, хто переплавляє й очищає срібло; \q {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} очистить нащадків Левія і переплавить їх, \q як золото й срібло, \q щоб вони належали {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} \q і приносили жертви в праведності.
uk.R: Він сяде, як майстер, що розплавляє срібло, щоб зробити його чистим. \q Він зробить чистими священників із племені Левія, \q як роблять чистими золото й срібло. \q Тоді вони приноситимуть жертви {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} \q так, як належить.

decisions.choice: he will sit as a refiner: watching the metal closely
decisions.reason: A refiner sat by the furnace and watched the molten silver, skimming off the dross until the metal was pure. The LORD's judgment is careful and patient, aimed at a pure result. |

decisions.choice: the sons of Levi: the priests of 1:6-2:9
decisions.reason: The priests who despised the LORD's name will be purified first, so that the covenant with Levi (2:4-7) is restored and the offerings become acceptable. Judgment begins at the house of God. |

decisions.choice: in righteousness: rightly, as they should be offered
decisions.reason: The offerings will be brought in the right way, by people right with God (Psalm 4:6; 51:21). |

decisions.choice: the sons of Levi (L), the descendants of Levi (B), the priests from the tribe of Levi (R); in righteousness (L, B), in the right way (R)
decisions.reason: The sons of Levi here are the priests, who were men, so no gender setting is used. |

decisions.choice: "Naye", "ataketi", "atawasafisha" with no deity_pronoun span; the second "naye" (L) with the span
decisions.reason: The English "he" is in the Swahili verb prefixes, which take no span. The joined "Naye" that opens the verse is written plainly with its capital, and the "naye" in the middle of the Literal sentence takes the span, as the book-wide rule at 1:3.

decisions.choice: "los hijos de Leví" (L); "los descendientes de Leví" (B); "los sacerdotes de la tribu de Leví" (R)
decisions.reason: The sons of Levi are the priests of 1:6-2:9; the levels follow the Spanish forms for "sons of" (L hijos, B descendientes) and R says who they are.

decisions.choice: com retidão (L, B); do jeito certo (R)
decisions.reason: Tsedaqah here is the right way of offering (m3); "retidão" is the word the prophets' Portuguese uses for this root, and "justiça" is kept for mishpat (2:17; 3:5). "Os filhos de Levi" are the priests, men, and "filhos" needs no setting.

decisions.choice: लेवी के पुत्र (L), लेवी के वंशज (B), लेवी के गोत्र के याजक (R)
decisions.reason: The sons of Levi here are the priests, who were men (m2), so no gender setting is used, as in the English. धार्मिकता is the key term at Literal and Balanced; Readable says सही रीति से (m3).

decisions.choice: benei Levi "レビの子ら" (L), "レビの子孫" (B), "レビの部族の祭司たち" (R); bitsdaqah "義のうちに" (L), "義をもって" (B), "正しいやり方で" (R).
decisions.reason: As the English per level; tsedaqah 義 here for what is right before God.

source.text: וְעָֽרְבָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה מִנְחַ֥ת יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּימֵ֣י עוֹלָ֔ם וּכְשָׁנִ֖ים קַדְמֹנִיּֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasing to Yahweh, as in [the] days of old and as in former years.

en.L: And the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q as in the days of long ago \q and as in the years of former times.
en.B: Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q as it was in days gone by, \q in years long past.
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be pleased with the offerings of the people of Judah and Jerusalem, \q as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was long ago, \q in years gone by.

fr.L: Et l’offrande de Juda et de Jérusalem sera agréable {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, \q comme aux jours d’autrefois \q et comme dans les années anciennes.
fr.B: Alors l’offrande de Juda et de Jérusalem sera agréable {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, \q comme dans les jours passés, \q dans les années d’autrefois.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera content des offrandes des gens de Juda et de Jérusalem, \q comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’était il y a longtemps, \q dans les années passées.

es.L: Y la ofrenda de Judá y de Jerusalén será agradable {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, \q como en los días de antaño \q y como en los años antiguos.
es.B: Entonces la ofrenda de Judá y de Jerusalén será agradable {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, \q como lo fue en los días pasados, \q en años ya lejanos.
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se agradará de las ofrendas de la gente de Judá y de Jerusalén, \q como se agradaba hace mucho tiempo, \q en los años pasados.

vi.L: Bấy giờ lễ vật của Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ đẹp lòng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q như trong những ngày xa xưa \q và như trong những năm thuở trước.
vi.B: Bấy giờ lễ vật của Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ đẹp lòng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q như trong những ngày xưa, \q trong những năm thuở trước.
vi.R: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ hài lòng về lễ vật của dân Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem, \q như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hài lòng thời xưa, \q trong những năm trước kia.

sw.L: Na sadaka ya Yuda na Yerusalemu itampendeza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kama katika siku za kale \q na kama katika miaka ya zamani.
sw.B: Ndipo sadaka ya Yuda na Yerusalemu itampendeza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kama ilivyokuwa siku zilizopita, \q katika miaka ya zamani.
sw.R: Ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atapendezwa na sadaka za watu wa Yuda na Yerusalemu, \q kama alivyopendezwa zamani, \q katika miaka iliyopita.

ko.L: 그러면 유다와 예루살렘의 예물이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기쁨이 될 것이다. \q 옛날과 같이, \q 지난 세월과 같이 [될 것이다].
ko.B: 그때에 유다와 예루살렘의 예물이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기쁨이 될 것이다. \q 지나간 날들에 그랬던 것처럼, \q 오래전 해들에 그랬던 것처럼 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다와 예루살렘 백성의 예물을 기쁘게 받으실 것이다. \q 오래전에 그러셨던 것처럼, \q 지난 세월에 그러셨던 것처럼 받으실 것이다.

pt.L: E a oferta de Judá e de Jerusalém será agradável {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, \q como nos dias antigos \q e como nos anos de outrora.
pt.B: Então a oferta de Judá e de Jerusalém será agradável {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, \q como foi nos dias passados, \q em anos de muito tempo atrás.
pt.R: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ficará contente com as ofertas do povo de Judá e de Jerusalém, \q como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ficava muito tempo atrás, \q em anos que já passaram.

am.L: የይሁዳና የኢየሩሳሌም መባም {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ደስ የሚያሰኝ ይሆናል፤ \q እንደ ቀድሞው ዘመን፣ \q እንደ ጥንቱም ዓመታት።
am.B: ከዚያም የይሁዳና የኢየሩሳሌም መባ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ደስ ያሰኛል፤ \q በቀድሞው ዘመን እንደ ነበረው፣ \q ባለፉት ዓመታት እንደ ነበረው።
am.R: ከዚያም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ሕዝብ መባ ደስ ይለዋል፤ \q ከብዙ ዘመን በፊት ደስ ይለው እንደ ነበረ፣ \q ባለፉት ዓመታት።

hi.L: और यहूदा और यरूशलेम की भेंट {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को भाएगी, \q जैसी प्राचीन दिनों में \q और पिछले वर्षों में [भाती थी]।
hi.B: तब यहूदा और यरूशलेम की भेंट {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को भाएगी, \q जैसी बीते दिनों में भाती थी, \q बहुत पहले के वर्षों में।
hi.R: तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यहूदा और यरूशलेम के लोगों की भेंटों से प्रसन्न होंगे, \q जैसे वे बहुत पहले प्रसन्न होते थे, \q बीते हुए वर्षों में।

ru.L: И будет приятно {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} приношение Иуды и Иерусалима, \q как во дни древности \q и как в годы прежние.
ru.B: Тогда приношение Иуды и Иерусалима будет угодно {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, \q как в былые дни, \q в давно минувшие годы.
ru.R: Тогда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} будет доволен приношениями жителей Иуды и Иерусалима, \q как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} был доволен давно, \q в прошлые годы.

ja.L: そしてユダとエルサレムのささげ物は、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に喜ばれるものとなる。 \q 昔の日々のように、 \q 以前の年々のように。
ja.B: そのとき、ユダとエルサレムのささげ物は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に喜ばれる。 \q 遠い昔の日々のように、 \q ずっと前の年々のように。
ja.R: そのとき、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ユダとエルサレムの人々のささげ物を喜ばれる。 \q ずっと昔に喜ばれたように。 \q 遠い過去の年々のように。

uk.L: І жертва Юди та Єрусалима буде приємна {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, \q як у дні давнини \q і як у роки колишні.
uk.B: Тоді жертва Юди та Єрусалима буде приємна {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, \q як це було в минулі дні, \q у давно минулі роки.
uk.R: Тоді {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} буде задоволений жертвами людей Юди та Єрусалима, \q як {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} був задоволений давно, \q у минулі роки.

decisions.choice: pleasing: sweet, acceptable
decisions.reason: The word is used of what is pleasant to the taste. Jeremiah 6:20 says that the people's sacrifices were not pleasing to the LORD; here they will be once more. |

decisions.choice: as in the days of old: as in the best times of Israel's past
decisions.reason: The days of old may be the time of Moses in the wilderness (Jeremiah 2:2-3) or of David and Solomon (1 Kings 8:62-64), when the people's worship was whole-hearted. |

decisions.choice: as he was long ago (R)
decisions.reason: Readable adds the comparison's verb. |

source.text: וְקָרַבְתִּ֣י אֲלֵיכֶם֮ לַמִּשְׁפָּט֒ וְהָיִ֣יתִי׀עֵ֣ד מְמַהֵ֗ר בַּֽמְכַשְּׁפִים֙ וּבַמְנָ֣אֲפִ֔ים וּבַנִּשְׁבָּעִ֖ים לַשָּׁ֑קֶר וּבְעֹשְׁקֵ֣י שְׂכַר־שָׂ֠כִיר אַלְמָנָ֨ה וְיָת֤וֹם וּמַטֵּי־גֵר֙ וְלֹ֣א יְרֵא֔וּנִי אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will draw near to you for judgment, and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers and against the adulterers and against those swearing to falsehood, and against those who oppress [the] wage of [the] hired worker, [the] widow and [the] fatherless, and who turn aside [the] sojourner, and do not fear me, says Yahweh of hosts.

en.L: And I will come near to you for judgment, \q and I will be a witness quick to act against the sorcerers, against the adulterers, \q and against those who swear to a lie, \q and against those who oppress the hired worker in wages, the widow and the fatherless, and who turn aside the sojourner, and do not fear {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts.
en.B: I will come near to you for judgment. \q I will be quick to testify against sorcerers and adulterers \q and those who swear falsely, \q against those who cheat hired workers of their wages, who oppress widows and orphans and deny justice to foreigners, and who do not fear {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: I will come to judge you. \q I will be quick to speak against those who practice witchcraft and those who commit adultery \q and those who lie under oath. \q I will speak against those who cheat workers out of their pay and treat widows and orphans badly, and against those who refuse justice to foreigners who live among you. None of them fear {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

fr.L: Et je {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}approcherai de vous pour le jugement, \q et je serai un témoin prompt contre les sorciers, contre les adultères, \q et contre ceux qui jurent pour le mensonge, \q et contre ceux qui oppriment le salarié dans son salaire, la veuve et l’orphelin, et qui écartent l’étranger, et ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} craignent pas, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.B: Je {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}approcherai de vous pour le jugement. \q Je témoignerai sans tarder contre les sorciers et les adultères \q et ceux qui font de faux serments, \q contre ceux qui volent l’ouvrier de son salaire, qui oppriment la veuve et l’orphelin et privent l’immigré de justice, et qui ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} craignent pas, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Je viendrai vous juger. \q Je parlerai sans tarder contre ceux qui pratiquent la sorcellerie et ceux qui commettent l’adultère, \q et ceux qui mentent sous serment. \q Je parlerai contre ceux qui volent les ouvriers en ne les payant pas, qui maltraitent les veuves et les orphelins, et contre ceux qui refusent la justice aux étrangers qui vivent parmi vous. Aucun d’eux ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} craint, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

es.L: Y me acercaré a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para el juicio, \q y seré testigo veloz contra los hechiceros, contra los adúlteros, \q y contra los que juran en falso, \q y contra los que defraudan en su salario al jornalero, a la viuda y al huérfano, y los que apartan al inmigrante, y no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} temen, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos.
es.B: Vendré a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para juzgar{{plural_you:los|os}}. \q Seré un testigo rápido contra los hechiceros y los adúlteros \q y contra los que juran en falso, \q contra los que defraudan a los jornaleros en su salario, los que oprimen a las viudas y a los huérfanos y niegan la justicia a los extranjeros, y no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} temen, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: Vendré a juzgar{{plural_you:los|os}}. \q Me apresuraré a acusar a los que practican la brujería y a los que cometen adulterio \q y a los que mienten bajo juramento. \q Acusaré a los que estafan a los trabajadores en su paga y maltratan a las viudas y a los huérfanos, y a los que niegan la justicia a los extranjeros que viven entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Ninguno de ellos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} teme, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

vi.L: Ta sẽ đến gần các ngươi để xét xử, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ mau chóng làm chứng nghịch cùng những kẻ phù phép, nghịch cùng những kẻ ngoại tình, \q nghịch cùng những kẻ thề dối, \q và nghịch cùng những kẻ áp bức người làm thuê trong tiền công, áp bức người góa bụa và kẻ mồ côi, và những kẻ xô đẩy khách lạ, mà không kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán.
vi.B: Ta sẽ đến gần các ngươi để xét xử. \q Ta sẽ nhanh chóng làm chứng nghịch cùng những kẻ phù phép và những kẻ ngoại tình, \q những kẻ thề dối, \q nghịch cùng những kẻ gian lận tiền công của người làm thuê, áp bức người góa bụa và trẻ mồ côi, chối bỏ công lý cho người ngoại kiều, và không kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán.
vi.R: Ta sẽ đến để xét xử các ngươi. \q Ta sẽ nhanh chóng lên tiếng tố cáo những kẻ làm phép phù thủy và những kẻ ngoại tình, \q cùng những kẻ thề dối. \q Ta sẽ tố cáo những kẻ quỵt tiền công của người làm thuê, ngược đãi người góa bụa và trẻ mồ côi, và những kẻ không chịu xử công bằng cho người nước ngoài sống giữa các ngươi. Chúng chẳng ai kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán.

sw.L: Nami nitawakaribia ninyi kwa ajili ya hukumu, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitakuwa shahidi mwepesi dhidi ya wachawi, dhidi ya wazinzi, \q na dhidi ya wale wanaoapa kwa uongo, \q na dhidi ya wale wanaomdhulumu mfanyakazi wa kuajiriwa katika mshahara wake, mjane na yatima, na wanaompotoshea mgeni haki, wala hawaniogopi, \q asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.B: Nitawakaribia ili kuhukumu. \q Nitakuwa mwepesi kushuhudia dhidi ya wachawi na wazinzi \q na wale wanaoapa kwa uongo, \q dhidi ya wale wanaowapunja wafanyakazi mishahara yao, wanaowaonea wajane na yatima na kuwanyima wageni haki, wasionicha, \q asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.R: Nitakuja kuwahukumu. \q Nitakuwa mwepesi kusema dhidi ya wale wanaofanya uchawi na wale wanaozini \q na wale wanaosema uongo baada ya kuapa. \q Nitasema dhidi ya wale wanaowapunja wafanyakazi malipo yao na kuwatendea vibaya wajane na yatima, na dhidi ya wale wanaowanyima haki wageni wanaoishi kati yenu. Hakuna hata mmoja wao anayeniogopa, \q anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.

ko.L: 내가 심판하러 너희에게 가까이 가겠다. \q 내가 무당들과 간음하는 자들과 \q 거짓으로 맹세하는 자들과, \q 품꾼의 품삯을 억누르고 과부와 고아를 억누르며 나그네를 밀어내고 나를 두려워하지 않는 자들에게 맞서, 서슴지 않고 증언하겠다. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.B: 내가 너희를 심판하러 가까이 가겠다. \q 나는 서슴지 않고 무당들과 간음하는 자들과 \q 거짓 맹세하는 자들에게 맞서 증언하겠다. \q 품꾼의 품삯을 떼어먹고, 과부와 고아를 억누르고, 나그네를 억울하게 하면서도 나를 두려워하지 않는 자들에게 맞서 증언하겠다. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 나는 너희를 심판하러 오겠다. \q 나는 서슴지 않고 마술을 하는 자들과 간음하는 자들과 \q 맹세하고 거짓말하는 자들을 고발하겠다. \q 일꾼들의 품삯을 떼어먹는 자들과 과부와 고아를 괴롭히는 자들, 너희 가운데 사는 외국인들을 억울하게 하는 자들도 고발하겠다. 그들은 모두 나를 두려워하지 않는다. \q 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: E eu me aproximarei de vocês para o juízo, \q e serei uma testemunha pronta [a agir] contra os feiticeiros, contra os adúlteros, \q e contra os que juram em falso, \q e contra os que oprimem o assalariado no salário, a viúva e o órfão, e que desviam o estrangeiro, e não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} temem, \q diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.B: Eu me aproximarei de vocês para julgar. \q Serei rápido em testemunhar contra os feiticeiros e os adúlteros \q e os que juram em falso, \q contra os que roubam o salário dos trabalhadores, que oprimem as viúvas e os órfãos e negam justiça aos estrangeiros, e que não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} temem, \q diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.R: Eu virei para julgar vocês. \q Vou ser rápido em falar contra os que praticam feitiçaria e os que cometem adultério \q e os que mentem debaixo de juramento. \q Vou falar contra os que enganam os trabalhadores no pagamento e maltratam as viúvas e os órfãos, e contra os que negam justiça aos estrangeiros que moram entre vocês. Nenhum deles {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} teme, \q diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.

am.L: ለፍርድም ወደ እናንተ እቀርባለሁ፤ \q በመተተኞችና በአመንዝሮች ላይ ፈጣን ምስክር እሆናለሁ፤ \q በሐሰትም በሚምሉ ላይ፣ \q የምንደኛውን ደመወዝ በሚቀሙ፣ መበለቲቱንና ድሀ አደጉን በሚያስጨንቁ፣ መጻተኛውንም [ከፍርድ] በሚያስወግዱ፣ እኔንም በማይፈሩ ላይ [ምስክር እሆናለሁ]፣ \q ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት።
am.B: ለፍርድ ወደ እናንተ እቀርባለሁ። \q በመተተኞችና በአመንዝሮች ላይ ፈጥኜ እመሰክራለሁ፤ \q በሐሰት በሚምሉም ላይ፣ \q የቅጥር ሠራተኞችን ደመወዝ በሚያጭበረብሩ፣ መበለቶችንና ድሀ አደጎችን በሚጨቁኑ፣ መጻተኞችንም ፍትሕ በሚነፍጉ፣ እኔንም በማይፈሩ ላይ እመሰክራለሁ፣ \q ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: እናንተን ለመፍረድ እመጣለሁ። \q መተት በሚያደርጉና በሚያመነዝሩ ላይ \q በሐሰትም በሚምሉ ላይ ፈጥኜ እመሰክራለሁ። \q ሠራተኞችን ደመወዛቸውን በሚያጭበረብሩ፣ መበለቶችንና ወላጅ የሌላቸውን ልጆች በሚበድሉ፣ በመካከላችሁ ለሚኖሩ ስደተኞችም ፍትሕ በሚከለክሉ ላይ እመሰክራለሁ። ከእነርሱ አንዳቸውም አይፈሩኝም፣ \q ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: और मैं न्याय के लिए तुम्हारे निकट आऊँगा, \q और मैं टोन्हों और व्यभिचारियों के विरुद्ध फुर्ती से साक्षी बनूँगा, \q और झूठी शपथ खानेवालों के विरुद्ध, \q और उनके विरुद्ध जो मज़दूर की मज़दूरी में, विधवा और अनाथ पर अंधेर करते हैं, और परदेशी को हटा देते हैं, और मेरा भय नहीं मानते, \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।
hi.B: मैं न्याय करने के लिए तुम्हारे निकट आऊँगा। \q मैं टोन्हों और व्यभिचारियों \q और झूठी शपथ खानेवालों के विरुद्ध गवाही देने में देर न करूँगा, \q उनके विरुद्ध भी जो मज़दूरों की मज़दूरी मारते हैं, विधवाओं और अनाथों पर अंधेर करते हैं, परदेशियों को न्याय से वंचित करते हैं, और मेरा भय नहीं मानते, \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।
hi.R: मैं तुम्हारा न्याय करने आऊँगा। \q मैं जादू-टोना करनेवालों और व्यभिचार करनेवालों \q और झूठी गवाही देनेवालों के विरुद्ध तुरंत बोलूँगा। \q मैं उनके विरुद्ध बोलूँगा जो मज़दूरों की मज़दूरी मारते हैं और विधवाओं और अनाथों के साथ बुरा व्यवहार करते हैं, और उनके विरुद्ध भी जो तुम्हारे बीच रहनेवाले परदेशियों को न्याय नहीं देते। इनमें से कोई मेरा भय नहीं मानता, \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} приближусь к вам для суда, \q и буду скорым свидетелем против чародеев и против прелюбодеев, \q и против клянущихся ложно, \q и против тех, кто притесняет наёмника в плате, вдову и сироту, и отталкивает пришельца, и не боится {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, \q — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф.
ru.B: Я приду к вам, чтобы судить. \q Я поспешу свидетельствовать против чародеев и прелюбодеев \q и против тех, кто клянётся ложно, \q против тех, кто обманом удерживает плату наёмных работников, притесняет вдов и сирот и лишает правосудия чужеземцев, и кто не боится {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, \q — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф.
ru.R: Я приду, чтобы судить вас. \q Я быстро выступлю против тех, кто занимается колдовством, и против тех, кто нарушает супружескую верность, \q и против тех, кто лжёт под клятвой. \q Я выступлю против тех, кто обманывает работников и не платит им, кто плохо обращается со вдовами и сиротами и отказывает в справедливости чужеземцам, которые живут среди вас. Никто из них не боится {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, \q — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств.

ja.L: そしてわたしは、裁きのためにあなたがたに近づく。 \q わたしは、呪術師たち、姦淫する者たちに対して、速やかな証人となる。 \q 偽って誓う者たちに対しても、 \q 雇い人の賃金をかすめ、やもめとみなしごをしいたげ、寄留者を押しのけ、わたしを恐れない者たちに対しても、 \q と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。
ja.B: わたしは裁きのために、あなたがたに近づく。 \q わたしは速やかに証言して、呪術を行う者と姦淫する者を訴え、 \q 偽って誓う者を訴える。 \q また、雇い人の賃金をごまかし、やもめとみなしごをしいたげ、寄留者の権利を退け、わたしを恐れない者たちを訴える、 \q と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。
ja.R: わたしは、あなたたちを裁くために来る。 \q わたしはすぐに、まじないをする者や、姦淫する者や、 \q うそを言って誓う者を訴える。 \q また、働く人の賃金をごまかす者、やもめや父親のいない子どもをひどく扱う者、あなたたちの間に住む外国人の権利を退ける者たちを訴える。彼らは皆、わたしを恐れない、 \q と天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наближуся до вас на суд, \q і буду свідком, швидким на дію, проти чаклунів, проти перелюбників, \q і проти тих, хто присягає неправдою, \q і проти тих, хто кривдить найманця в платні, вдову й сироту, і хто відштовхує приходька, і не боїться {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, \q говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот.
uk.B: Я наближуся до вас на суд. \q Я швидко свідчитиму проти чаклунів і перелюбників \q і тих, хто присягає неправдиво, \q проти тих, хто ошукує найманців у платні, хто гнобить вдів і сиріт і відмовляє приходькам у справедливості, і хто не боїться {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, \q говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ.
uk.R: Я прийду, щоб судити вас. \q Я швидко виступлю проти тих, хто займається чаклунством, і тих, хто чинить перелюб, \q і тих, хто бреше під присягою. \q Я виступлю проти тих, хто ошукує працівників у платні й кривдить вдів і сиріт, і проти тих, хто відмовляє в справедливості чужинцям, які живуть серед вас. Ніхто з них не боїться {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, \q каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель.

decisions.choice: I will draw near to you for judgment: the answer to "Where is the God of justice?"
decisions.reason: The people asked where the God of justice was (2:17). He answers that he himself will come to judge, quickly and as a witness who has seen everything. |

decisions.choice: sorcerers, adulterers, perjurers, oppressors: sins the law condemns
decisions.reason: Each sin named breaks the law: sorcery (Exodus 22:17; Deuteronomy 18:10), adultery (Exodus 20:14), false oaths (Leviticus 19:12), withholding a worker's wages (Leviticus 19:13; Deuteronomy 24:14-15), and wronging the widow, the fatherless and the foreigner (Exodus 22:20-23; Deuteronomy 24:17; 27:19). |

decisions.choice: the fatherless, the sojourner: the orphan, and the foreigner living among the people
decisions.reason: The fatherless child and the resident foreigner had no family to defend them, so the law put them under God's special protection. "Turn aside the sojourner" means to deny him his rights (Deuteronomy 27:19). |

decisions.choice: orphans (B, R); foreigners (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the everyday words. Readable makes "do not fear me" a sentence of its own. |

decisions.choice: "huérfano"; "inmigrante" (L); "extranjeros" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The sojourner is worded as in Zechariah 7:10 and Deuteronomy 10:18 in Spanish.

decisions.choice: "서슴지 않고 … 증언하겠다" placed after the list (L) and before it (B, R)
decisions.reason: Korean puts the verb last, so Literal holds "I will be a witness quick to act" until the end of the list; B and R put it first and repeat the verb, as the line breaks require. God answers the people's "Where is the God of justice?" (2:17).

decisions.choice: o órfão; o estrangeiro
decisions.reason: "Órfão" is the ordinary Portuguese word for the fatherless child, so every level uses it; the sojourner is "o estrangeiro", as the terms list has it for ger, with Readable adding "que moram entre vocês" as the English does.

decisions.choice: sorcerers "መተተኞች" (as Exodus 7:11 and Deuteronomy 18:10); adulterers "አመንዝሮች"; the fatherless "ድሀ አደግ" (L, B); the sojourner (ger) "መጻተኛ" (L, B), "ስደተኛ" (R)
decisions.reason: The sins are those the law names (meaning decision m2), so the law's Amharic words are used, as the Pentateuch list sets them.

decisions.choice: टोन्हे (L, B), जादू-टोना करनेवाले (R); अनाथ; परदेशी
decisions.reason: The fatherless is अनाथ at every level and the sojourner परदेशी, as the Ezra forms set for ger (m3). The sorcerers are टोन्हे, the word of Exodus 7:11; Readable says what they do.

decisions.choice: "пришелец" (L); "чужеземцы" (B, R); "сирота" at every level
decisions.reason: The sojourner and the fatherless in the forms of Deuteronomy 26:12 in Russian, level by level.

decisions.choice: mekhashefim "呪術師" (L), "呪術を行う者" (B), "まじないをする者" (R) (ISA / DEU); na'af "姦淫する"; 'almanah "やもめ"; yatom "みなしご" (L, B), "父親のいない子ども" (R); ger "寄留者" (L, B), "あなたたちの間に住む外国人" (R, as the English R).
decisions.reason: OT word forms already settled.

source.text: כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א שָׁנִ֑יתִי וְאַתֶּ֥ם בְּנֵֽי־יַעֲקֹ֖ב לֹ֥א כְלִיתֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For I, Yahweh, do not change; and you, sons of Jacob, have not come to an end.

en.L: For I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, do not change; \q and you, {{gender:children|sons}} of Jacob, have not come to an end.
en.B: I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and I do not change; \q that is why you, descendants of Jacob, have not been destroyed.
en.R: I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and I never change. \q That is why you, the people of Jacob, have not been destroyed.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je ne change pas ; \q et vous, {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Jacob, vous n’avez pas été consumés.
fr.B: Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et je ne change pas ; \q c’est pourquoi vous, descendants de Jacob, vous n’avez pas été anéantis.
fr.R: Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et je ne change jamais. \q C’est pour cela que vous, le peuple de Jacob, vous n’avez pas été détruits.

es.L: Porque yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, no cambio; \q y {{plural_you:ustedes, hijos de Jacob, no han sido consumidos|vosotros, hijos de Jacob, no habéis sido consumidos}}.
es.B: Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y no cambio; \q por eso {{plural_you:ustedes, descendientes de Jacob, no han sido destruidos|vosotros, descendientes de Jacob, no habéis sido destruidos}}.
es.R: Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y nunca cambio. \q Por eso {{plural_you:ustedes, pueblo de Jacob, no han sido destruidos|vosotros, pueblo de Jacob, no habéis sido destruidos}}.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không thay đổi; \q và các ngươi, hỡi con cái Gia-cốp, đã không bị tiêu diệt.
vi.B: Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không thay đổi; \q vì vậy các ngươi, là dòng dõi Gia-cốp, đã không bị tiêu diệt.
vi.R: Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không bao giờ thay đổi. \q Vì vậy các ngươi, là dân của Gia-cốp, đã không bị tiêu diệt.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sibadiliki; \q nanyi, wana wa Yakobo, hamjakoma.
sw.B: Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} sibadiliki; \q ndiyo sababu ninyi, wazao wa Yakobo, hamjaangamizwa.
sw.R: Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} sibadiliki kamwe. \q Ndiyo sababu ninyi, watu wa Yakobo, hamjaangamizwa.

ko.L: 나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 변하지 않는다. \q 그러므로 야곱의 자손들아, 너희가 멸망하지 않았다.
ko.B: 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다. 나는 변하지 않는다. \q 그래서 야곱의 자손인 너희가 망하지 않은 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다. 나는 결코 변하지 않는다. \q 그래서 야곱의 백성인 너희가 망하지 않은 것이다.

pt.L: Pois eu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, não mudo; \q e vocês, filhos de Jacó, não chegaram ao fim.
pt.B: Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e não mudo; \q por isso vocês, descendentes de Jacó, não foram destruídos.
pt.R: Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, e eu nunca mudo. \q É por isso que vocês, o povo de Jacó, não foram destruídos.

am.L: እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አልለወጥምና፤ \q እናንተም የያዕቆብ ልጆች ሆይ፣ አላለቃችሁም።
am.B: እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ፤ አልለወጥም፤ \q ስለዚህ እናንተ የያዕቆብ ዘሮች አልጠፋችሁም።
am.R: እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ፤ ከቶ አልለወጥም። \q ስለዚህ እናንተ የያዕቆብ ሕዝብ አልጠፋችሁም።

hi.L: क्योंकि मैं, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, बदलता नहीं; \q और तुम, हे {{gender:याकूब की सन्तान|याकूब के पुत्रो}}, नाश नहीं हुए।
hi.B: मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ, और मैं बदलता नहीं; \q इसी कारण तुम, हे याकूब के वंशजो, नाश नहीं हुए।
hi.R: मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ, और मैं कभी नहीं बदलता। \q इसीलिए तुम, याकूब के लोग, नाश नहीं हुए।

ru.L: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, не изменяюсь; \q и вы, {{gender:дети Иакова|сыны Иакова}}, не исчезли.
ru.B: Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не изменяюсь; \q поэтому вы, потомки Иакова, не погибли.
ru.R: Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} никогда не меняюсь. \q Поэтому вы, народ Иакова, не уничтожены.

ja.L: まことに、わたし、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は変わらない。 \q そして、ヤコブの子らよ、あなたがたは滅び尽きていない。
ja.B: わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であって、変わることがない。 \q だから、ヤコブの子孫よ、あなたがたは滅ぼされなかった。
ja.R: わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}だ。わたしは決して変わらない。 \q だから、ヤコブの子孫であるあなたたちは、滅ぼされなかった。

uk.L: Бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, не змінююся; \q а ви, {{gender:діти|сини}} Якова, не зникли.
uk.B: Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не змінююся; \q тому ви, нащадки Якова, не знищені.
uk.R: Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ніколи не змінююся. \q Тому ви, народ Якова, не знищені.

decisions.choice: I, the LORD, do not change: the LORD is faithful to his covenant
decisions.reason: The LORD's character and his promises stay the same (Numbers 23:19; Psalm 102:28). That is why Jacob's descendants still exist, though they have turned from him again and again (verse 7). |

decisions.choice: you have not come to an end: you have not been destroyed
alternatives: you have not ceased to be what Jacob was
decisions.reason: The verb means "come to an end, be finished". Most read it as "you have not been destroyed", because the LORD is faithful. Some read it as a rebuke, "you have not stopped" being like Jacob, the deceiver, which would lead into verse 7.

decisions.choice: a new dispute begins
decisions.reason: The fourth dispute (3:6-12) concerns the people's turning away from the LORD and their withholding of tithes. |

decisions.choice: children of Jacob (L, gender default), descendants (B), people (R)
decisions.reason: The sons of Jacob are the whole people, men and women. |

decisions.choice: "hijos de Jacob"
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" includes daughters, so L needs no gender span, as the term sheet sets.

decisions.choice: "con cái Gia-cốp" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "con cái" already includes sons and daughters; there is no second wording to offer.

decisions.choice: "야곱의 자손들" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "자손" covers both "children" and "sons", so the English gender span has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Jacob (L)
decisions.reason: The same setting as the English Literal, in the form the term sheet gives for "the sons of Israel".

decisions.choice: "wana wa Yakobo" (L), with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Wana" covers sons and daughters alike, so the English gender setting has nothing to change in Swahili.

decisions.choice: filhos de Jacó (L), no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English Literal puts "children / sons of Jacob" under the gender setting; Portuguese "filhos" already includes daughters (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md), so Literal says "filhos de Jacó" with no span.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "የያዕቆብ ልጆች" (L)
decisions.reason: The English offers "children / sons of Jacob". "ልጆች" already includes daughters, so the Amharic has no span, as the Pentateuch list sets for "the sons of Israel".

decisions.choice: {{gender:याकूब की सन्तान|याकूब के पुत्रो}} (L); वंशज (B), लोग (R)
decisions.reason: The sons of Jacob are the whole people, women and men, so Literal uses the gender setting, as the English does; Balanced and Readable use words that already include everyone.

decisions.choice: {{gender:дети Иакова|сыны Иакова}} (L); "потомки" (B), "народ" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the English: the sons of Jacob are the whole people, men and women, so Literal uses the gender setting.

decisions.choice: "ヤコブの子ら" with no gender span, where the English L has children|sons.
decisions.reason: "子ら" is already inclusive in Japanese.

source.text: לְמִימֵ֨י אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֜ם סַרְתֶּ֤ם מֵֽחֻקַּי֙ וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַרְתֶּ֔ם שׁ֤וּבוּ אֵלַי֙ וְאָשׁ֣וּבָה אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּמֶּ֥ה נָשֽׁוּב׃

records.literal_gloss: From [the] days of your fathers you have turned aside from my statutes and have not kept [them]. Return to me, and I will return to you, says Yahweh of hosts. And you say, In what shall we return?

en.L: From the days of your fathers you have turned aside from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and have not kept [them]. \q Turn back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will turn back to you, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts. \q But you say, "How shall we return?"
en.B: Ever since the days of your ancestors you have strayed from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and failed to keep them. \q Return to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will turn to you again, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. \q Yet you ask, "In what way shall we return?"
en.R: Ever since your ancestors lived, you have turned away from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} laws and have not obeyed them. \q Come back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will come back to you, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. \q But you ask, "How can we come back?"

fr.L: Depuis les jours de vos pères, vous vous êtes écartés de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions et ne [les] avez pas gardées. \q Revenez à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et je reviendrai à vous, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Mais vous dites : « En quoi reviendrons-nous ? »
fr.B: Depuis le temps de vos ancêtres, vous vous êtes détournés de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions et vous ne les avez pas gardées. \q Revenez à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et je reviendrai à vous, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Et vous demandez : « En quoi devons-nous revenir ? »
fr.R: Depuis l’époque de vos ancêtres, vous vous êtes détournés de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} lois et vous ne leur avez pas obéi. \q Revenez à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et je reviendrai à vous, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Mais vous dites : « Comment pouvons-nous revenir ? »

es.L: Desde los días de {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}} {{plural_you:se han apartado|os habéis apartado}} de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos y no [los] {{plural_you:han guardado|habéis guardado}}. \q {{plural_you:Vuélvanse|Volveos}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y yo me volveré a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos. \q Pero {{plural_you:ustedes dicen|vosotros decís}}: «¿En qué hemos de volvernos?».
es.B: Desde los días de {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} {{plural_you:se han desviado|os habéis desviado}} de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos y no los {{plural_you:han cumplido|habéis cumplido}}. \q {{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y yo volveré a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. \q Pero {{plural_you:ustedes preguntan|vosotros preguntáis}}: «¿De qué manera hemos de volver?».
es.R: Desde los tiempos de {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} {{plural_you:se han alejado|os habéis alejado}} de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} leyes y no las {{plural_you:han obedecido|habéis obedecido}}. \q {{plural_you:Regresen|Regresad}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y yo regresaré a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. \q Pero {{plural_you:ustedes preguntan|vosotros preguntáis}}: «¿Cómo podemos regresar?».

vi.L: Từ thời tổ phụ các ngươi, các ngươi đã lìa bỏ các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và không giữ [chúng]. \q Hãy quay về với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ quay về với các ngươi, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. \q Nhưng các ngươi nói: "Chúng tôi phải quay về bằng cách nào?"
vi.B: Từ thời tổ tiên các ngươi, các ngươi đã đi lệch khỏi luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và không tuân giữ. \q Hãy trở lại với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trở lại với các ngươi, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. \q Thế mà các ngươi hỏi: "Chúng tôi phải trở lại bằng cách nào?"
vi.R: Từ thời tổ tiên các ngươi, các ngươi đã quay lưng với luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và không vâng giữ. \q Hãy trở lại với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trở lại với các ngươi, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. \q Thế mà các ngươi hỏi: "Chúng tôi phải trở lại bằng cách nào?"

sw.L: Tangu siku za baba zenu mmegeuka mbali na kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} wala hamkuzishika. \q Nirudieni, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawarudia, \q asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. \q Lakini mnasema, "Tutarudi kwa namna gani?"
sw.B: Tangu siku za babu zenu mmezikengeuka kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} wala hamkuzishika. \q Nirudieni, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawageukia tena, \q asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. \q Lakini mnauliza, "Turudi kwa njia gani?"
sw.R: Tangu wakati wa babu zenu mmeziacha sheria {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} wala hamkuzitii. \q Rudini {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitarudi kwenu, \q anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. \q Lakini mnauliza, "Tunawezaje kurudi?"

ko.L: 너희 조상들의 날부터 너희는 내 규례에서 벗어나 [그것을] 지키지 않았다. \q 나에게 돌아오너라. 그러면 나도 너희에게 돌아가겠다. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 그런데 너희는 "저희가 어떻게 돌아가야 합니까?" 하고 말한다.
ko.B: 너희는 조상 때부터 내 규례를 떠나 지키지 않았다. \q 나에게 돌아오너라. 그러면 나도 너희에게 돌아가겠다. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 그런데 너희는 "저희가 무엇에서 돌아가야 합니까?" 하고 묻는다.
ko.R: 너희는 조상 때부터 내 법을 저버리고 지키지 않았다. \q 나에게 돌아오너라. 그러면 나도 너희에게 돌아가겠다. \q 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 그런데 너희는 "저희가 어떻게 돌아가야 한다는 말입니까?" 하고 묻는다.

pt.L: Desde os dias dos pais de vocês, vocês se desviaram dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} estatutos e não [os] guardaram. \q Voltem para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, e eu voltarei para vocês, \q diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos. \q Mas vocês dizem: "Em que voltaremos?"
pt.B: Desde os dias dos antepassados de vocês, vocês se desviaram dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} estatutos e não os guardaram. \q Voltem para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, e eu voltarei para vocês, \q diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos. \q Mas vocês perguntam: "De que maneira voltaremos?"
pt.R: Desde o tempo dos seus antepassados, vocês se afastaram das {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} leis e não as obedeceram. \q Voltem para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, e eu voltarei para vocês, \q diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos. \q Mas vocês perguntam: "Como podemos voltar?"

am.L: ከአባቶቻችሁ ዘመን ጀምሮ ከሥርዓቶቼ ፈቀቅ ብላችኋል፤ አልጠበቃችኋቸውምም። \q ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ፤ እኔም ወደ እናንተ እመለሳለሁ፣ \q ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት። \q እናንተ ግን፦ «የምንመለሰው እንዴት ነው?» ትላላችሁ።
am.B: ከአባቶቻችሁ ዘመን ጀምሮ ከሥርዓቶቼ ርቃችኋል፤ አልጠበቃችኋቸውምም። \q ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ፤ እኔም እንደገና ወደ እናንተ እመለሳለሁ፣ \q ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። \q እናንተ ግን፦ «በምን መንገድ እንመለሳለን?» ብላችሁ ትጠይቃላችሁ።
am.R: ከአባቶቻችሁ ዘመን ጀምሮ ከሕጎቼ ዞር ብላችኋል፤ አልታዘዛችኋቸውምም። \q ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ፤ እኔም ወደ እናንተ እመለሳለሁ፣ \q ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። \q እናንተ ግን፦ «እንዴት ልንመለስ እንችላለን?» ብላችሁ ትጠይቃላችሁ።

hi.L: अपने पुरखाओं के दिनों से तुम मेरी विधियों से हटते आए हो और [उनका] पालन नहीं किया। \q मेरी ओर लौटो, और मैं तुम्हारी ओर लौटूँगा, \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। \q पर तुम कहते हो, "हम किस बात में लौटें?"
hi.B: अपने पूर्वजों के समय से ही तुम मेरी विधियों से भटकते आए हो और उनका पालन नहीं किया। \q मेरी ओर फिरो, और मैं फिर तुम्हारी ओर फिरूँगा, \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। \q फिर भी तुम पूछते हो, "हम किस प्रकार लौटें?"
hi.R: जब से तुम्हारे पूर्वज जीवित थे, तब से तुम मेरे नियमों से मुँह मोड़ते आए हो और तुमने उन्हें नहीं माना। \q मेरे पास लौट आओ, और मैं तुम्हारे पास लौट आऊँगा, \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। \q पर तुम पूछते हो, "हम कैसे लौटें?"

ru.L: Со дней ваших отцов вы отступили от {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} установлений и не соблюдали [их]. \q Обратитесь ко {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} обращусь к вам, \q — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф. \q А вы говорите: «В чём нам обратиться?»
