hi.R: तब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भय माननेवाले लोगों ने आपस में बातें कीं, \q और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने ध्यान देकर सुना कि वे क्या कह रहे हैं। \q उनके सामने एक लेखा लिखा गया \q उन लोगों का जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भय मानते और उनके नाम का आदर करते थे।

ru.L: Тогда боящиеся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} говорили друг с другом; \q и {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} внимал и слышал, \q и была написана памятная книга перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} \q для боящихся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и чтущих {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя.
ru.B: Тогда те, кто боялся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, говорили друг с другом, \q и {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} внимательно слушал и услышал их. \q Перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} была написана памятная книга \q о тех, кто боится {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и чтит {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя.
ru.R: Тогда люди, которые боялись {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, говорили друг с другом, \q и {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} слушал и слышал, что они говорят. \q В {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} присутствии была написана книга, \q где записаны те, кто боится {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и чтит {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя.

ja.L: そのとき、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を恐れる者たちが、互いに語り合った。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は耳を傾けて聞かれ、 \q その方の前で、覚えの書が書き記された。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を恐れ、その名を尊ぶ者たちのために。
ja.B: そのとき、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を畏れる者たちが互いに語り合った。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は耳を傾けて、それを聞かれた。 \q その方の前で、覚えの書が書き記された。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を畏れ、その名を尊ぶ者たちについての書である。
ja.R: そのとき、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をおそれ敬う人々が、互いに話し合った。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、耳を傾けて、彼らの言うことを聞かれた。 \q その方の前で、記録が書き記された。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をおそれ敬い、その名を大切にする人々の記録である。

uk.L: Тоді ті, хто боявся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, говорили одне з одним; \q і {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} зважив і почув, \q і була написана книга памʼяті перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} \q для тих, хто боїться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і шанує {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя.
uk.B: Тоді ті, хто боявся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, розмовляли між собою, \q і {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} слухав і почув їх. \q Перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} була написана книга памʼяті \q про тих, хто боїться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і шанує {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя.
uk.R: Тоді люди, які боялися {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, розмовляли між собою, \q і {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} слухав і почув, що вони казали. \q Перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} був написаний список \q тих, хто боїться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і шанує {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя.

decisions.choice: then those who feared the LORD spoke: the faithful answer differently
decisions.reason: The verse turns from the LORD's words to what happened next. Those who feared the LORD also spoke together, but not as the complainers did, and the LORD heard them. |

decisions.choice: a book of remembrance: a record of those to be remembered
decisions.reason: Kings kept records of deeds that deserved reward (Esther 6:1-3). Scripture speaks of God's book in which his people's names are written (Exodus 32:32; Psalm 69:29; Daniel 12:1). |

decisions.choice: esteem his name: think highly of him, value him
decisions.reason: The verb means to think, consider, and so to value. They give the LORD's name the honor the priests withheld (1:6). |

decisions.choice: spoke with one another (L), talked with one another (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "each with his neighbor", which includes everyone, so the levels say "with one another". |

decisions.choice: 3:16 is narrative: passé simple at L and B, passé composé at R
decisions.reason: The one narrative verse among Malachi's disputations, as the term sheet's narrative rule.

decisions.choice: "un libro de memoria" (L, B); "un registro" (R)
decisions.reason: The book of remembrance is a record of those to be remembered; R says "registro", as the English R says "record".

decisions.choice: "quyển sách ghi nhớ" (L, B) / "bản ghi chép" (R)
decisions.reason: "Sử Ký" is kept only as the title of Chronicles; this is a written record kept before God.

decisions.choice: The last two lines change places in Korean (L, B)
decisions.reason: Korean puts "for those who feared the LORD" before "a book of remembrance was written", so the third and fourth English lines are given in the opposite order; both stay within the verse.

decisions.choice: um livro de memória (L, B); um registro (R)
decisions.reason: The record of those to be remembered (m2) is "um livro de memória" at Literal and Balanced, keeping the Hebrew "book of remembrance"; Readable says "um registro", as the English Readable says "a record".

decisions.choice: a book of remembrance "የመታሰቢያ መጽሐፍ" (L, B), "መዝገብ" (R); esteem his name "ስሙን ያስባሉ" (L), "ስሙን ያከብራሉ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew verb "think, consider"; Balanced and Readable say "honour", as the English, the sense meaning decision m3 gives.

decisions.choice: आपस में; स्मरण की पुस्तक (L, B), लेखा (R)
decisions.reason: "Each with his neighbor" includes everyone, so every level says आपस में, as the English says "one another". The book of remembrance (m2) is स्मरण की पुस्तक; Readable says a record.

decisions.choice: yir'ei YHWH "主を恐れる者" (L), "主を畏れる者" (B), "主をおそれ敬う人々" (R) (ISA); sefer zikkaron "覚えの書" (L, B), "記録" (R); light respect forms for the LORD ("聞かれた").
decisions.reason: The prophet narrates; ISA forms for the fear of the LORD.

source.text: וְהָ֣יוּ לִ֗י אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת לַיּ֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֣ה סְגֻלָּ֑ה וְחָמַלְתִּ֣י עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ יַחְמֹ֣ל אִ֔ישׁ עַל־בְּנ֖וֹ הָעֹבֵ֥ד אֹתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will be mine, says Yahweh of hosts, on the day when I act, a treasured possession; and I will spare them as a man spares his son who serves him.

en.L: And they will be {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, \q for the day when I act, \q a special possession; \q and I will spare them \q as a man spares his son who serves him.
en.B: They will be {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, \q {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} special treasure \q on the day when I act. \q I will spare them \q as a father spares the son who serves him.
en.R: They will belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. \q On the day when I act, they will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} special treasure. \q I will have mercy on them, \q as a father has mercy on a son who serves him.

fr.L: Et ils seront à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, \q pour le jour où j’agirai, \q un trésor particulier ; \q et je les épargnerai \q comme un homme épargne son fils qui le sert.
fr.B: Ils seront à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, \q {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} trésor \q au jour où j’agirai. \q Je les épargnerai \q comme un père épargne le fils qui le sert.
fr.R: Ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartiendront, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Au jour où j’agirai, ils seront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} trésor. \q J’aurai pitié d’eux, \q comme un père a pitié d’un fils qui le sert.

es.L: Y serán {{deity_pronoun:míos|Míos}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, \q para el día en que yo actúe, \q posesión preciada; \q y los perdonaré \q como el hombre perdona a su hijo que le sirve.
es.B: Ellos serán {{deity_pronoun:míos|Míos}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, \q {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} tesoro personal \q en el día en que yo actúe. \q Los perdonaré \q como un padre perdona al hijo que le sirve.
es.R: Ellos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenecerán, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. \q En el día en que yo actúe, serán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} tesoro personal. \q Tendré compasión de ellos, \q como un padre tiene compasión del hijo que le sirve.

vi.L: Họ sẽ thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán, \q trong ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hành động, \q [làm] của riêng quý báu; \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thương tiếc họ \q như người cha thương tiếc con trai mình là đứa phục vụ mình.
vi.B: Họ sẽ thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán, \q là báu vật riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \q trong ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hành động. \q Ta sẽ thương xót họ \q như người cha thương xót đứa con trai phục vụ mình.
vi.R: Họ sẽ thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. \q Vào ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hành động, họ sẽ là báu vật riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Ta sẽ thương xót họ, \q như người cha thương xót đứa con trai phục vụ mình.

sw.L: Nao watakuwa {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, \q kwa siku ile nitakapotenda, \q milki ya pekee; \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawahurumia \q kama mtu amhurumiavyo mwanawe anayemtumikia.
sw.B: Watakuwa {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, \q hazina {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ya pekee \q katika siku ile nitakapotenda. \q Nitawahurumia \q kama baba amhurumiavyo mwana anayemtumikia.
sw.R: Watakuwa mali {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. \q Katika siku ile nitakapotenda, watakuwa hazina {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ya pekee. \q Nitawahurumia, \q kama baba anavyomhurumia mwana anayemtumikia.

ko.L: 그들이 내 것이 될 것이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 내가 일하는 그날에 \q [그들이] 내 특별한 소유가 될 것이다. \q 내가 그들을 아끼기를, \q 사람이 자기를 섬기는 아들을 아끼듯이 하겠다.
ko.B: 그들은 내 것이 될 것이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 그들은 내 소중한 보물이 될 것이다. \q 내가 일하는 그날에 그렇게 될 것이다. \q 내가 그들을 아끼겠다. \q 아버지가 자기를 섬기는 아들을 아끼듯이 아끼겠다.
ko.R: 그들은 내 것이 될 것이다. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 내가 일하는 그날에 그들은 내 특별한 보물이 될 것이다. \q 나는 그들을 불쌍히 여기겠다. \q 아버지가 자기를 섬기는 아들을 불쌍히 여기듯이 하겠다.

pt.L: E eles serão {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}}, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, \q para o dia em que eu agir, \q uma propriedade especial; \q e eu os pouparei \q como um homem poupa o seu filho que o serve.
pt.B: Eles serão {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}}, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, \q o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} tesouro especial \q no dia em que eu agir. \q Eu os pouparei \q como um pai poupa o filho que o serve.
pt.R: Eles vão pertencer a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos. \q No dia em que eu agir, eles serão o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} tesouro especial. \q Eu terei compaixão deles, \q como um pai tem compaixão de um filho que o serve.

am.L: ለእኔም ይሆናሉ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት፣ \q ለማደርግበት ቀን፣ \q የግል ሀብት፤ \q እራራላቸዋለሁም፤ \q ሰው የሚያገለግለውን ልጁን እንደሚራራለት።
am.B: የእኔ ይሆናሉ፣ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ \q ውድ ሀብቴ ይሆናሉ \q በማደርግበት ቀን። \q እራራላቸዋለሁ፤ \q አባት የሚያገለግለውን ልጁን እንደሚራራለት።
am.R: የእኔ ይሆናሉ፣ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። \q በማደርግበት ቀን ውድ ሀብቴ ይሆናሉ። \q ምሕረት አደርግላቸዋለሁ፤ \q አባት ለሚያገለግለው ልጁ ምሕረት እንደሚያደርግ።

hi.L: और वे मेरे होंगे, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं, \q उस दिन के लिए जब मैं काम करूँगा, \q मेरा निज धन; \q और मैं उन पर ऐसी दया करूँगा \q जैसे कोई मनुष्य अपने पुत्र पर करता है जो उसकी सेवा करता है।
hi.B: वे मेरे होंगे, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं, \q मेरा अपना विशेष धन, \q उस दिन जब मैं काम करूँगा। \q मैं उन पर ऐसी दया करूँगा \q जैसे पिता अपने उस पुत्र पर करता है जो उसकी सेवा करता है।
hi.R: वे मेरे होंगे, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। \q जिस दिन मैं काम करूँगा, उस दिन वे मेरा अपना ख़ास ख़ज़ाना होंगे। \q मैं उन पर दया करूँगा, \q जैसे पिता अपने उस पुत्र पर दया करता है जो उसकी सेवा करता है।

ru.L: И они будут {{deity_pronoun:моими|Моими}}, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, — \q в день, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду действовать, \q собственностью; \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} пощажу их, \q как человек щадит своего сына, служащего ему.
ru.B: Они будут {{deity_pronoun:моими|Моими}}, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, — \q {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} особым сокровищем \q в тот день, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду действовать. \q Я пощажу их, \q как отец щадит сына, который служит ему.
ru.R: Они будут принадлежать {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств. \q В тот день, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду действовать, они будут {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} особым сокровищем. \q Я буду милостив к ним, \q как отец милостив к сыну, который ему служит.

ja.L: 彼らはわたしのものとなる、と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q わたしが行動する日に、 \q [わたしの]宝となる。 \q わたしは彼らを惜しむ。 \q 人が自分に仕える息子を惜しむように。
ja.B: 彼らはわたしのものとなる、と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q わたしの特別な宝となる。 \q わたしが行動するその日に。 \q わたしは彼らを惜しむ。 \q 父が自分に仕える息子を惜しむように。
ja.R: 彼らはわたしのものとなる、と天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q わたしが行動するその日に、彼らはわたしの大切な宝物となる。 \q わたしは彼らをあわれむ。 \q 父親が、自分に仕える息子をあわれむように。

uk.L: І вони будуть {{deity_pronoun:моїми|Моїми}}, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот, \q на день, коли {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} діятиму, \q особливою власністю; \q і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} пощаджу їх, \q як чоловік щадить свого сина, що служить йому.
uk.B: Вони будуть {{deity_pronoun:моїми|Моїми}}, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ, \q {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} особливим скарбом \q у день, коли {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} діятиму. \q Я пощаджу їх, \q як батько щадить сина, що служить йому.
uk.R: Вони належатимуть {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель. \q У день, коли {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} діятиму, вони будуть {{deity_pronoun:моїм|Моїм}} особливим скарбом. \q Я змилуюся над ними, \q як батько милує сина, що служить йому.

decisions.choice: a special possession: the LORD's own treasure
decisions.reason: The word was used of a king's private treasure. At Sinai the LORD called Israel his special possession among all peoples (Exodus 19:5; Deuteronomy 7:6; 26:18). Here the title belongs to those who fear him. |

decisions.choice: on the day when I act, a special possession
alternatives: on the day when I make up my special possession
decisions.reason: The words can be read "on the day when I make [them] a special possession" or "on the day when I act, [they will be] a special possession". The same phrase "the day when I act" returns in verse 21, which supports the second reading.

decisions.choice: spare them as a man spares his son who serves him: show them a father's compassion
decisions.reason: The complainers said that serving God brings no profit (verse 14). The LORD answers that he will treat those who serve him as a loving father treats a son who serves him. |

decisions.choice: special possession (L), special treasure (B, R); as a man (L), a father (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word keeps the wording published at Exodus 19:5: "special possession" (L) and "special treasure" (B, R). The man is the son's father, so Balanced and Readable say "father". |

decisions.choice: segullah "un trésor particulier" (L), "mon trésor" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and the published Exodus 19:5.

decisions.choice: "posesión preciada" (L); "tesoro personal" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The segullah reuses the Spanish of Exodus 19:5 at each level, as the English reuses its Exodus wording.

decisions.choice: segullah "của riêng quý báu" (L) / "báu vật riêng" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Reused from the published Exodus 19:5 at each level, as the term sheet says. L says "người cha" where the Hebrew has "a man", since "his son" makes it a father in Vietnamese too.

decisions.choice: "특별한 소유" (L); "소중한 보물" (B); "특별한 보물" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for segullah, after Exodus 19:5.

decisions.choice: "milki ya pekee" (L); "hazina yangu ya pekee" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The published Swahili of Exodus 19:5 for segullah, as the term sheet.

decisions.choice: uma propriedade especial (L); o meu tesouro especial (B, R)
decisions.reason: Segullah keeps the Portuguese published at Exodus 19:5 (m1): "propriedade especial" at Literal and "tesouro especial" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: special possession (segullah) "የግል ሀብት" (L), "ውድ ሀብት" (B, R), as Exodus 19:5 on main; the day when I act "በማደርግበት ቀን", the same in 3:21
decisions.reason: The word recalls the LORD's words at Sinai (meaning decision m1), so it keeps the Amharic of Exodus 19:5.

decisions.choice: "особлива власність" (L), "особливий скарб" (B, R), as the English "special possession" and "special treasure"
decisions.reason: The word is the one used of Israel in Exodus 19:5; the Ukrainian follows the English levels so that the echo can be made the same wherever the word recurs.

decisions.choice: निज धन (L), अपना विशेष धन (B), अपना ख़ास ख़ज़ाना (R)
decisions.reason: The special possession (segullah, m1) keeps the wording of Exodus 19:5 in this translation at each level. The man is the son's father, so Balanced and Readable say पिता, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "собственностью" (L); "особым сокровищем" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word (segullah) keeps the Russian wording of Exodus 19:5, level by level.

decisions.choice: segullah "[わたしの]宝" (L), "特別な宝" (B), "大切な宝物" (R), as Exodus 19:5; chamal "惜しむ" (L, B), "あわれむ" (R).
decisions.reason: Exodus forms for the same covenant word.

source.text: וְשַׁבְתֶּם֙ וּרְאִיתֶ֔ם בֵּ֥ין צַדִּ֖יק לְרָשָׁ֑ע בֵּ֚ין עֹבֵ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֔ים לַאֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א עֲבָדֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And you will again see [the difference] between [the] righteous and [the] wicked, between one serving God and one who has not served him.

en.L: And you will again see \q [the difference] between the righteous and the wicked, \q between one who serves God \q and one who does not serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Then once more you will see the difference \q between the righteous and the wicked, \q between the one who serves God \q and the one who does not serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Then you will see again the difference \q between people who do what is right and people who do evil, \q between those who serve God \q and those who do not.

fr.L: Et vous verrez de nouveau \q [la différence] entre le juste et le méchant, \q entre celui qui sert Dieu \q et celui qui ne {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sert pas.
fr.B: Alors vous verrez de nouveau la différence \q entre le juste et le méchant, \q entre celui qui sert Dieu \q et celui qui ne {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sert pas.
fr.R: Alors vous verrez de nouveau la différence \q entre les gens qui font ce qui est juste et ceux qui font le mal, \q entre ceux qui servent Dieu \q et ceux qui ne le servent pas.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:volverán a ver|volveréis a ver}} \q [la diferencia] entre el justo y el malvado, \q entre el que sirve a Dios \q y el que no {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sirve.
es.B: Entonces {{plural_you:verán|veréis}} otra vez la diferencia \q entre el justo y el malvado, \q entre el que sirve a Dios \q y el que no {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sirve.
es.R: Entonces {{plural_you:verán|veréis}} otra vez la diferencia \q entre los que hacen lo correcto y los que hacen el mal, \q entre los que sirven a Dios \q y los que no.

vi.L: Bấy giờ các ngươi sẽ lại thấy \q [sự khác biệt] giữa người công chính và kẻ gian ác, \q giữa người phục vụ Đức Chúa Trời \q và kẻ không phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Bấy giờ các ngươi sẽ lại thấy sự khác biệt \q giữa người công chính và kẻ gian ác, \q giữa người phục vụ Đức Chúa Trời \q và kẻ không phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Bấy giờ các ngươi sẽ lại thấy sự khác biệt \q giữa người làm điều ngay thẳng và kẻ làm điều ác, \q giữa những người phục vụ Đức Chúa Trời \q và những kẻ không phục vụ.

sw.L: Nanyi mtaona tena \q [tofauti] kati ya mwenye haki na mwovu, \q kati ya yeye anayemtumikia Mungu \q na yeye asiyemtumikia.
sw.B: Ndipo mtaona tena tofauti \q kati ya mwenye haki na mwovu, \q kati ya yule anayemtumikia Mungu \q na yule asiyemtumikia.
sw.R: Ndipo mtaona tena tofauti \q kati ya watu wanaotenda yaliyo sawa na watu wanaotenda maovu, \q kati ya wale wanaomtumikia Mungu \q na wale wasiomtumikia.

ko.L: 너희가 다시 \q 의인과 악인 사이, \q 하나님을 섬기는 자와 \q 그분을 섬기지 않는 자 사이[의 차이를] 볼 것이다.
ko.B: 그때 너희는 다시 \q 의인과 악인의 차이를, \q 하나님을 섬기는 사람과 \q 그분을 섬기지 않는 사람의 차이를 보게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그때 너희는 다시 \q 옳은 일을 하는 사람과 악한 일을 하는 사람이 어떻게 다른지, \q 하나님을 섬기는 사람과 \q 섬기지 않는 사람이 어떻게 다른지 보게 될 것이다.

pt.L: E vocês voltarão a ver \q [a diferença] entre o justo e o ímpio, \q entre o que serve a Deus \q e o que não {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} serve.
pt.B: Então vocês verão outra vez a diferença \q entre o justo e o ímpio, \q entre quem serve a Deus \q e quem não {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} serve.
pt.R: Então vocês vão ver de novo a diferença \q entre as pessoas que fazem o que é certo e as que fazem o mal, \q entre as que servem a Deus \q e as que não servem.

am.L: እናንተም ተመልሳችሁ ታያላችሁ \q በጻድቁና በክፉው መካከል [ያለውን ልዩነት]፣ \q እግዚአብሔርን በሚያገለግለው \q እርሱንም በማያገለግለው መካከል።
am.B: ከዚያም እንደገና ልዩነቱን ታያላችሁ፤ \q በጻድቁና በክፉው መካከል፣ \q እግዚአብሔርን በሚያገለግለውና \q እርሱን በማያገለግለው መካከል።
am.R: ከዚያም ልዩነቱን እንደገና ታያላችሁ፤ \q ትክክል የሆነውን በሚያደርጉና ክፉ በሚያደርጉ ሰዎች መካከል፣ \q እግዚአብሔርን በሚያገለግሉና \q በማያገለግሉት መካከል።

hi.L: और तुम फिर से देखोगे \q धर्मी और दुष्ट के बीच [का अंतर], \q जो परमेश्वर की सेवा करता है \q और जो उनकी सेवा नहीं करता, उनके बीच।
hi.B: तब तुम एक बार फिर अंतर देखोगे \q धर्मी और दुष्ट के बीच, \q परमेश्वर की सेवा करनेवाले \q और उनकी सेवा न करनेवाले के बीच।
hi.R: तब तुम फिर से अंतर देखोगे \q उन लोगों में जो सही काम करते हैं और उनमें जो बुरे काम करते हैं, \q उनमें जो परमेश्वर की सेवा करते हैं \q और उनमें जो नहीं करते।

ru.L: И вы снова увидите \q [различие] между праведным и нечестивым, \q между служащим Богу \q и тем, кто не служит {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}.
ru.B: Тогда вы снова увидите разницу \q между праведным и нечестивым, \q между тем, кто служит Богу, \q и тем, кто не служит {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}.
ru.R: Тогда вы снова увидите разницу \q между людьми, которые поступают правильно, и людьми, которые делают зло, \q между теми, кто служит Богу, \q и теми, кто не служит.

ja.L: あなたがたは再び、 \q 正しい者と悪しき者との間[の違い]を見る。 \q 神に仕える者と \q その方に仕えない者との間[の違い]を。
ja.B: そのとき、あなたがたは再び見分けるようになる。 \q 正しい人と悪しき者との違いを、 \q 神に仕える者と \q その方に仕えない者との違いを。
ja.R: そのとき、あなたたちは再び、違いがわかるようになる。 \q 正しいことをする人と悪いことをする人との違い、 \q 神に仕える人と \q 仕えない人との違いが。

uk.L: І ви знову побачите \q [різницю] між праведним і нечестивим, \q між тим, хто служить Богові, \q і тим, хто не служить {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}.
uk.B: Тоді ви знову побачите різницю \q між праведним і нечестивим, \q між тим, хто служить Богові, \q і тим, хто не служить {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}.
uk.R: Тоді ви знову побачите різницю \q між людьми, які роблять те, що правильно, і людьми, які чинять зло, \q між тими, хто служить Богові, \q і тими, хто не служить.

decisions.choice: you will again see: you will once more see
decisions.reason: The words are literally "you will return and see", meaning "you will see again". The complainers said that the wicked and the righteous fare alike (verse 15); the day of the LORD will show the difference. |

decisions.choice: the righteous and the wicked: those who do right before God and those who do not
decisions.reason: The pair is the one of Psalm 1:6. Here it is defined by service: those who serve God and those who do not. |

decisions.choice: people who do what is right and people who do evil (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what the two words mean. |

decisions.choice: "asiyemtumikia", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The English "him" is the Swahili object marker "-m-", which takes no span.

decisions.choice: tsaddiq "正しい者" (L), "正しい人" (B), R by the English R; rasha' "悪しき者" (L, B), "悪いことをする人" (R) (ISA key words).
decisions.reason: Prophetic key-word table.

source.text: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֤ה הַיּוֹם֙ בָּ֔א בֹּעֵ֖ר כַּתַּנּ֑וּר וְהָי֨וּ כָל־זֵדִ֜ים וְכָל־עֹשֵׂ֤ה רִשְׁעָה֙ קַ֔שׁ וְלִהַ֨ט אֹתָ֜ם הַיּ֣וֹם הַבָּ֗א אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־יַעֲזֹ֥ב לָהֶ֖ם שֹׁ֥רֶשׁ וְעָנָֽף׃

records.literal_gloss: For look, the day is coming, burning like an oven, and all [the] arrogant and every doer of wickedness will be stubble, and the day that is coming will set them ablaze, says Yahweh of hosts, so that it will not leave them root or branch.

en.L: For look, the day is coming, \q burning like an oven, \q and all the arrogant and every doer of wickedness will be stubble; \q and the day that is coming will set them ablaze, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, \q so that it will leave them neither root nor branch.
en.B: For see, the day is coming, \q blazing like a furnace, \q when all the arrogant and all evildoers will be stubble. \q The day that is coming will set them on fire, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, \q and leave them neither root nor branch.
en.R: Look! The day is coming. \q It will burn like a hot oven. \q All the proud people and all who do evil will be like dry straw. \q On that day they will be burned up, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. \q Nothing will be left of them, not a root or a branch.

fr.L: Car voici, le jour vient, \q brûlant comme un four, \q et tous les arrogants et tous ceux qui font le mal seront du chaume ; \q et le jour qui vient les embrasera, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, \q de sorte qu’il ne leur laissera ni racine ni rameau.
fr.B: Car voici que le jour vient, \q ardent comme une fournaise, \q où tous les arrogants et tous ceux qui font le mal seront comme du chaume. \q Le jour qui vient les embrasera, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, \q et ne leur laissera ni racine ni branche.
fr.R: Regardez ! Le jour arrive. \q Il brûlera comme un four très chaud. \q Tous les orgueilleux et tous ceux qui font le mal seront comme de la paille sèche. \q Ce jour-là, ils seront brûlés, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Il ne restera rien d’eux, ni racine ni branche.

es.L: Porque he aquí, viene el día, \q ardiente como un horno, \q y todos los soberbios y todos los que hacen maldad serán paja; \q y el día que viene los abrasará, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, \q de modo que no les dejará ni raíz ni rama.
es.B: Porque ya viene el día, \q ardiente como un horno, \q en que todos los soberbios y todos los malvados serán paja. \q El día que viene les prenderá fuego, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, \q y no les dejará ni raíz ni rama.
es.R: ¡Atención! Ya viene el día. \q Arderá como un horno caliente. \q Todos los orgullosos y todos los que hacen el mal serán como paja seca. \q Ese día serán quemados, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. \q No quedará nada de ellos, ni raíz ni rama.

vi.L: Vì kìa, ngày ấy đang đến, \q cháy như lò lửa, \q và mọi kẻ kiêu ngạo cùng mọi kẻ làm điều gian ác sẽ như rơm rạ; \q ngày đang đến sẽ thiêu đốt chúng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán, \q đến nỗi không để lại cho chúng rễ hay cành.
vi.B: Vì này, ngày ấy đang đến, \q cháy rực như lò lửa, \q khi mọi kẻ kiêu ngạo và mọi kẻ làm ác sẽ như rơm rạ. \q Ngày đang đến sẽ thiêu đốt chúng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán, \q chẳng để lại cho chúng rễ hay cành.
vi.R: Hãy xem! Ngày ấy đang đến. \q Nó sẽ cháy như lò lửa nóng. \q Mọi kẻ kiêu ngạo và mọi kẻ làm ác sẽ như rơm khô. \q Vào ngày ấy chúng sẽ bị thiêu rụi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. \q Chẳng còn gì sót lại của chúng, dù là rễ hay cành.

sw.L: Kwa maana tazama, siku inakuja, \q ikiwaka kama tanuri, \q nao wote wenye kiburi na kila atendaye uovu watakuwa makapi; \q nayo siku ile inayokuja itawateketeza, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, \q hata isiwaachie shina wala tawi.
sw.B: Kwa maana tazama, siku inakuja, \q ikiwaka kama tanuru, \q ambapo wote wenye kiburi na watenda mabaya wote watakuwa makapi. \q Siku ile inayokuja itawachoma moto, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, \q isiwaachie shina wala tawi.
sw.R: Tazama! Siku inakuja. \q Itawaka kama tanuri la moto mkali. \q Watu wote wenye kiburi na wote wanaotenda mabaya watakuwa kama nyasi kavu. \q Siku hiyo wataungua kabisa, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. \q Hakuna kitakachobaki kwao, hata shina wala tawi.

ko.L: 보라, 그날이 온다. \q 화덕처럼 타오르는 [날이다]. \q 모든 교만한 자와 악을 행하는 자는 모두 지푸라기가 될 것이다. \q 다가오는 그날이 그들을 불사를 것이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 그날은 그들에게 뿌리도 가지도 남기지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 보아라, 그날이 온다. \q 용광로처럼 활활 타오르는 날이다. \q 그날에 모든 교만한 자와 악을 행하는 자는 모두 지푸라기가 될 것이다. \q 다가오는 그날이 그들을 불살라 버릴 것이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 그들에게 뿌리도 가지도 남지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 보아라! 그날이 오고 있다. \q 그날은 뜨거운 화덕처럼 타오를 것이다. \q 교만한 사람들과 악한 일을 하는 사람들은 모두 마른 지푸라기처럼 될 것이다. \q 그날에 그들은 다 타 버릴 것이다. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 뿌리 하나, 가지 하나도 남지 않을 것이다.

pt.L: Pois eis que o dia vem, \q ardendo como um forno, \q e todos os arrogantes e todo aquele que pratica a maldade serão palha; \q e o dia que vem os incendiará, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, \q de modo que não lhes deixará nem raiz nem ramo.
pt.B: Pois vejam: o dia está chegando, \q ardente como uma fornalha, \q quando todos os arrogantes e todos os que praticam o mal serão palha. \q O dia que está chegando vai incendiá-los, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, \q e não lhes deixará nem raiz nem ramo.
pt.R: Olhem! O dia está chegando. \q Ele vai queimar como um forno quente. \q Todos os orgulhosos e todos os que fazem o mal serão como palha seca. \q Naquele dia eles serão queimados por completo, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos. \q Não vai sobrar nada deles, nem raiz nem galho.

am.L: እነሆ፣ ቀኑ ይመጣልና፤ \q እንደ ምድጃ የሚነድድ፤ \q ትዕቢተኞች ሁሉ ክፋትንም የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ገለባ ይሆናሉ፤ \q የሚመጣውም ቀን ያቃጥላቸዋል፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት፤ \q ሥርንም ቅርንጫፍንም አይተውላቸውም።
am.B: ቀኑ ይመጣልና፤ \q እንደ እቶን የሚነድድ፤ \q በዚያም ትዕቢተኞች ሁሉና ክፉ አድራጊዎች ሁሉ ገለባ ይሆናሉ። \q የሚመጣው ቀን ያነድዳቸዋል፣ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ \q ሥርም ቅርንጫፍም አያስቀርላቸውም።
am.R: ተመልከቱ! ቀኑ ይመጣል። \q እንደ ጋለ ምድጃ ይነድዳል። \q ትዕቢተኞች ሁሉና ክፉ የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ እንደ ደረቅ ገለባ ይሆናሉ። \q በዚያ ቀን ይቃጠላሉ፣ ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። \q ሥርም ሆነ ቅርንጫፍ ምንም አይቀርላቸውም።

hi.L: क्योंकि देखो, वह दिन आ रहा है, \q भट्ठे के समान जलता हुआ, \q और सब अभिमानी और सब दुष्टता करनेवाले भूसा बन जाएँगे; \q और वह आनेवाला दिन उन्हें भस्म कर देगा, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं, \q यहाँ तक कि वह उनकी न जड़ छोड़ेगा न डाली।
hi.B: क्योंकि देखो, वह दिन आ रहा है, \q भट्ठी के समान धधकता हुआ, \q जब सब अभिमानी और सब बुराई करनेवाले भूसा होंगे। \q वह आनेवाला दिन उन्हें आग लगा देगा, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं, \q और उनकी न जड़ छोड़ेगा न डाली।
hi.R: देखो! वह दिन आ रहा है। \q वह तपते हुए तंदूर की तरह जलेगा। \q सब घमंडी लोग और सब बुरे काम करनेवाले सूखे भूसे के समान होंगे। \q उस दिन वे जलकर भस्म हो जाएँगे, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। \q उनका कुछ भी नहीं बचेगा, न जड़ न डाली।

ru.L: Ведь вот, приходит день, \q горящий, как печь, \q и все надменные и всякий делающий нечестие будут соломой; \q и спалит их грядущий день, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, — \q так что не оставит им ни корня, ни ветви.
ru.B: Ведь вот, приходит день, \q пылающий, как горн, \q когда все надменные и все злодеи станут соломой. \q Грядущий день сожжёт их, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, — \q и не оставит им ни корня, ни ветви.
ru.R: Смотрите! Приходит день. \q Он будет пылать, как раскалённая печь. \q Все гордецы и все, кто делает зло, будут как сухая солома. \q В тот день они сгорят, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств. \q От них ничего не останется, ни корня, ни ветки.

ja.L: まことに、見なさい、その日が来る。 \q かまどのように燃える[日が]。 \q 高ぶる者たち、悪を行う者たちはみな、わらとなる。 \q 来るべきその日は、彼らを焼き尽くす、と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q それは、彼らに根も枝も残さない。
ja.B: 見なさい、その日が来る。 \q 炉のように燃えさかる日が。 \q そのとき、高ぶる者と悪を行う者はみな、わらとなる。 \q 来るべきその日は、彼らを燃え上がらせる、と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q そして、彼らに根も枝も残さない。
ja.R: 見なさい！その日が来る。 \q その日は、熱いかまどのように燃える。 \q 高ぶる人々も、悪いことをする人々もみな、乾いたわらのようになる。 \q その日、彼らは焼き尽くされる、と天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q 彼らには、根も枝も何一つ残らない。

uk.L: Бо ось приходить день, \q палаючий, як піч, \q і всі зухвалі й кожен, хто чинить беззаконня, будуть стернею; \q і день, що приходить, спалить їх, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот, \q так що не залишить їм ні кореня, ні гілки.
uk.B: Бо ось приходить день, \q що палає, як горно, \q коли всі зухвалі й усі лиходії будуть стернею. \q День, що приходить, спалить їх, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ, \q і не залишить їм ні кореня, ні гілки.
uk.R: Дивіться! Приходить день. \q Він палатиме, як розпечена піч. \q Усі горді люди й усі, хто чинить зло, будуть, як суха солома. \q Того дня вони згорять, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель. \q Від них нічого не залишиться, ні кореня, ні гілки.

decisions.choice: This verse is 3:19 in the Hebrew text, 4:1 in many other Bibles
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text ends the book with chapter 3, so the six verses 3:19-24 are one chapter with what goes before. Many Bibles, following the Greek and Latin, make them a fourth chapter, so their 4:1-6 is 3:19-24 here. Open Word Bible follows the numbering of the Hebrew text it translates, and Malachi is cited by the Hebrew numbers.

decisions.choice: an oven: a clay baking oven, fired very hot
decisions.reason: The oven was a clay cylinder heated with a fire inside. Stubble thrown into it burned up at once. |

decisions.choice: neither root nor branch: nothing at all left
decisions.reason: A tree with neither root nor branch is gone entirely (compare Amos 2:9). The arrogant whom the complainers called blessed (verse 15) will be burned up like stubble. |

decisions.choice: oven (L), furnace (B), hot oven (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the household baking oven; Balanced says "furnace" for its heat. Readable says "dry straw" for "stubble". |

decisions.choice: "horno" at every level
decisions.reason: The oven is a clay oven fired very hot; Spanish "horno" covers both the English "oven" and "furnace". The meaning decision's footnote gives the other numbering (4:1).

decisions.choice: "tanuri" (L, R) for the baking oven; "tanuru" (B) for a furnace
decisions.reason: As the English, which has "oven" at Literal and Readable and "furnace" at Balanced; "tanuri" is a baking oven and "tanuru" the furnace of Daniel 3.

decisions.choice: Verse 3:19, which Korean Protestant Bibles number 4:1
decisions.reason: The text follows the Hebrew numbering, as the English does (meaning decision); Korean readers know Malachi 3:19-24 as 4:1-6, so the footnote of the meaning decision applies to them too.

decisions.choice: oven "ምድጃ" (L), furnace "እቶን" (B), hot oven "የጋለ ምድጃ" (R); stubble "ገለባ"
decisions.reason: The words follow the English levels and the forms on main (Hosea 7:4 "ምድጃ", Isaiah 48:10 "እቶን"). The verse number is the Hebrew one (4:1 in many Bibles), as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: भट्ठा (L), भट्ठी (B), तपता हुआ तंदूर (R); भूसा
decisions.reason: The word is the clay baking oven, fired very hot (m2); Balanced says भट्ठी for its heat, as the English says furnace, and Readable तंदूर, the Hindi clay oven. This verse is 3:19 in the Hebrew, 4:1 in many Hindi Bibles (m1).

decisions.choice: "печь" (L), "горн" (B), "раскалённая печь" (R)
decisions.reason: The household baking oven (m2); Balanced says "горн" for its heat, as the English Balanced says "furnace". The verse is 4:1 in many Bibles (m1).

decisions.choice: tannur "かまど" (L), "炉" (B), "熱いかまど" (R); qash "わら"; the Hebrew verse numbers 3:19-24 are kept (4:1-6 in many Bibles).
decisions.reason: As the English per level; numbering follows the source.

source.text: וְזָרְחָ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם יִרְאֵ֤י שְׁמִי֙ שֶׁ֣מֶשׁ צְדָקָ֔ה וּמַרְפֵּ֖א בִּכְנָפֶ֑יהָ וִֽיצָאתֶ֥ם וּפִשְׁתֶּ֖ם כְּעֶגְלֵ֥י מַרְבֵּֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: But for you who fear my name the sun of righteousness will rise, and healing [will be] in its wings; and you will go out and leap like calves of [the] stall.

en.L: But for you who fear {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name there will rise a sun of righteousness, \q and healing [will be] in its wings; \q and you will go out and frisk like calves of the stall.
en.B: But for you who revere {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, the sun of righteousness will rise, \q bringing healing in its wings. \q You will go out leaping like calves let out of the stall.
en.R: But for you who honor {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, the sun of righteousness will rise. \q Its rays will bring healing. \q You will go out and jump for joy like calves let out of their stalls.

fr.L: Mais pour vous qui craignez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom se lèvera un soleil de justice, \q et la guérison [sera] dans ses ailes ; \q et vous sortirez et vous bondirez comme des veaux de l’étable.
fr.B: Mais pour vous qui révérez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, le soleil de justice se lèvera, \q portant la guérison dans ses ailes. \q Vous sortirez en bondissant comme des veaux qu’on lâche de l’étable.
fr.R: Mais pour vous qui honorez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, le soleil de justice se lèvera. \q Ses rayons apporteront la guérison. \q Vous sortirez en sautant de joie, comme des veaux qu’on fait sortir de l’étable.

es.L: Pero para {{plural_you:ustedes, los que temen|vosotros, los que teméis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, nacerá un sol de justicia, \q y en sus alas [habrá] sanidad; \q y {{plural_you:saldrán y saltarán|saldréis y saltaréis}} como becerros del establo.
es.B: Pero para {{plural_you:ustedes, los que reverencian|vosotros, los que reverenciáis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, saldrá el sol de justicia \q trayendo sanidad en sus alas. \q {{plural_you:Saldrán|Saldréis}} brincando como becerros sueltos del establo.
es.R: Pero para {{plural_you:ustedes, los que honran|vosotros, los que honráis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, saldrá el sol de justicia. \q Sus rayos traerán sanidad. \q {{plural_you:Saldrán y saltarán|Saldréis y saltaréis}} de alegría como becerros que salen del establo.

vi.L: Nhưng cho các ngươi là những người kính sợ danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, mặt trời công chính sẽ mọc lên, \q và sự chữa lành [sẽ ở] trong cánh nó; \q các ngươi sẽ đi ra và nhảy nhót như bò con trong chuồng.
vi.B: Nhưng cho các ngươi là những người kính sợ danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, mặt trời công chính sẽ mọc lên, \q mang sự chữa lành trong cánh nó. \q Các ngươi sẽ đi ra, nhảy nhót như bò con được thả khỏi chuồng.
vi.R: Nhưng cho các ngươi là những người tôn kính danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, mặt trời công chính sẽ mọc lên. \q Tia sáng của nó mang sự chữa lành. \q Các ngươi sẽ đi ra và nhảy mừng như bò con được thả ra khỏi chuồng.

sw.L: Lakini kwenu ninyi mnaolicha jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} jua la haki litachomoza, \q na uponyaji [utakuwa] katika mabawa yake; \q nanyi mtatoka na kurukaruka kama ndama wa zizini.
sw.B: Lakini kwenu ninyi mnaolicha jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, jua la haki litachomoza, \q likileta uponyaji katika mabawa yake. \q Mtatoka mkirukaruka kama ndama walioachiliwa kutoka zizini.
sw.R: Lakini kwenu ninyi mnaoliheshimu jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, jua la haki litachomoza. \q Mionzi yake italeta uponyaji. \q Mtatoka na kurukaruka kwa furaha kama ndama walioachiliwa kutoka mazizini mwao.

ko.L: 그러나 내 이름을 경외하는 너희에게는 의의 해가 떠오를 것이니, \q 그 날개에 치료하는 힘이 있다. \q 너희가 나가서 외양간의 송아지들처럼 뛰놀 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 내 이름을 경외하는 너희에게는 의의 해가 떠올라, \q 그 날개로 치료를 가져올 것이다. \q 너희는 외양간에서 풀려난 송아지들처럼 뛰어나와 뛰놀 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 내 이름을 높이는 너희에게는 의의 해가 떠오를 것이다. \q 그 햇살이 병을 고칠 것이다. \q 너희는 외양간에서 풀려난 송아지들처럼 기뻐 뛰며 나갈 것이다.

pt.L: Mas para vocês que temem o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome nascerá um sol de justiça, \q e cura [haverá] nas suas asas; \q e vocês sairão e saltitarão como bezerros do estábulo.
pt.B: Mas para vocês que reverenciam o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome nascerá o sol da justiça, \q trazendo cura nas suas asas. \q Vocês sairão saltando como bezerros soltos do estábulo.
pt.R: Mas para vocês que honram o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome, o sol da justiça vai nascer. \q Os seus raios vão trazer cura. \q Vocês vão sair pulando de alegria como bezerros soltos do curral.

am.L: ስሜን ለምትፈሩ ለእናንተ ግን የጽድቅ ፀሐይ ትወጣለች፤ \q በክንፎቿም ፈውስ [ይሆናል]፤ \q እናንተም ትወጣላችሁ፤ እንደ ጋጣ ጥጆችም ትፈነጫላችሁ።
am.B: ስሜን ለምትፈሩ ለእናንተ ግን የጽድቅ ፀሐይ ትወጣለች፤ \q በክንፎቿም ፈውስን ታመጣለች። \q ከጋጣ እንደ ተለቀቁ ጥጆችም እየፈነጫችሁ ትወጣላችሁ።
am.R: ስሜን ለምታከብሩ ለእናንተ ግን የጽድቅ ፀሐይ ትወጣለች። \q ጨረሮቿ ፈውስ ያመጣሉ። \q ከጋጣቸው እንደ ተለቀቁ ጥጆች በደስታ እየዘለላችሁ ትወጣላችሁ።

hi.L: पर तुम्हारे लिए जो मेरे नाम का भय मानते हो, धार्मिकता का सूर्य उदय होगा, \q और उसके पंखों में चंगाई [होगी]; \q और तुम निकलकर थान के बछड़ों की तरह उछलोगे।
hi.B: पर तुम्हारे लिए जो मेरे नाम का भय मानते हो, धार्मिकता का सूर्य उदय होगा, \q जिसके पंखों में चंगाई होगी। \q तुम थान से छोड़े गए बछड़ों की तरह उछलते हुए निकलोगे।
hi.R: पर तुम्हारे लिए जो मेरे नाम का आदर करते हो, धार्मिकता का सूर्य उदय होगा। \q उसकी किरणें चंगाई लाएँगी। \q तुम थान से छोड़े गए बछड़ों की तरह आनंद से उछलते-कूदते निकलोगे।

ru.L: А для вас, боящихся {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} имени, взойдёт солнце праведности, \q и исцеление [будет] в его крыльях; \q и вы выйдете и будете скакать, как телята из стойла.
ru.B: А для вас, благоговеющих перед {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} именем, взойдёт солнце праведности, \q неся исцеление в своих крыльях. \q Вы выйдете и будете прыгать, как телята, выпущенные из стойла.
ru.R: А для вас, почитающих {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} имя, взойдёт солнце праведности. \q Его лучи принесут исцеление. \q Вы выйдете и будете прыгать от радости, как телята, выпущенные из стойла.

ja.L: しかし、わたしの名を恐れるあなたがたには、義の太陽が昇る。 \q その翼には癒やしがある。 \q あなたがたは出て行き、牛舎の子牛のように跳ね回る。
ja.B: しかし、わたしの名を畏れるあなたがたには、義の太陽が昇り、 \q その翼に癒やしをもたらす。 \q あなたがたは、牛舎から放たれた子牛のように、跳びはねながら出て行く。
ja.R: しかし、わたしの名をおそれ敬うあなたたちには、義の太陽が昇る。 \q その光は、いやしをもたらす。 \q あなたたちは、小屋から出された子牛のように、喜んで跳びはねながら出て行く。

uk.L: А для вас, що боїтеся {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} імені, зійде сонце праведності, \q і зцілення [буде] в його крилах; \q і ви вийдете й скакатимете, як телята зі стійла.
uk.B: А для вас, хто шанує {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} імʼя, зійде сонце праведності \q зі зціленням у його крилах. \q Ви вийдете, стрибаючи, як телята, випущені зі стійла.
uk.R: А для вас, хто шанує {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}} імʼя, зійде сонце праведності. \q Його проміння принесе зцілення. \q Ви вийдете й стрибатимете з радості, як телята, випущені зі стійла.

decisions.choice: the sun of righteousness: righteousness rising like the sun
decisions.reason: The LORD's righteousness, his putting things right and vindicating his people, will dawn on them like the sun (Isaiah 58:8; 60:1-3; Psalm 37:6). The day that burns the arrogant (verse 19) brings light and healing to those who fear him. |

decisions.choice: healing in its wings: healing carried by its rays
decisions.reason: The sun's rays are pictured as wings spreading over the earth (compare Psalm 139:9, "the wings of the dawn"). In the ancient Near East the sun was often shown as a disk with wings. |

decisions.choice: the sun of righteousness and later Christian reading
decisions.reason: Christians have long applied the phrase to Christ, linking it with "the dawn from on high" in Luke 1:78. The text speaks of the coming of the LORD's righteousness. The phrase is lowercase as a picture, not a title. |

decisions.choice: calves of the stall: young cattle released from the stall
decisions.reason: Calves kept in a stall to be fattened leap and run when let out into the open. |

decisions.choice: the sun of righteousness at every level, lowercase
decisions.reason: The phrase is kept at every level ("a sun of righteousness" at Literal, which has no article, as the Hebrew), because readers know it and the picture is the point; Readable explains the wings as rays. |

decisions.choice: "le soleil de justice", lowercase, at every level; "la guérison dans ses ailes" (L, B), "Ses rayons apporteront la guérison" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet; no deity_pronoun span on "ses", which refers to the sun.

decisions.choice: "un sol de justicia" (L); "el sol de justicia" (B, R), lowercase
decisions.reason: The wording follows the term sheet at each level and keeps "sol" lowercase, as the English does; the meaning decision gives the later Christian reading.

decisions.choice: "mặt trời công chính", lowercase; "sự chữa lành trong cánh nó" (L, B) / "tia sáng của nó mang sự chữa lành" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording; the sun is "nó", as the English keeps it lowercase and unspanned. Those who fear God are now addressed tenderly, but the term sheet keeps "các ngươi" through Malachi.

decisions.choice: "jua la haki", lowercase, at every level
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and the English: the phrase is an image, not a title, and takes no capital and no deity span.

decisions.choice: "의의 해" at every level; "그 날개에 치료하는 힘이 있다" (L); "그 날개로 치료를 가져올 것이다" (B); "그 햇살이 병을 고칠 것이다" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet: the image stays at every level, as the English keeps it, and Readable explains the wings as rays.

decisions.choice: um sol de justiça (L); o sol da justiça (B, R), lowercase
decisions.reason: The phrase readers know (m1, m3) is kept at every level, as the English keeps it: "o sol da justiça", with "um sol de justiça" at Literal, which has no article as the Hebrew. Elsewhere this root is "retidão" (3:3), but "sol da retidão" would hide the familiar picture; "justiça" here means God's putting things right, as m1 says.

decisions.choice: the sun of righteousness "የጽድቅ ፀሐይ" at every level; calves of the stall "የጋጣ ጥጆች", as Amos 6:4
decisions.reason: The phrase stays a picture of the LORD's righteousness dawning (meaning decision m1), not a title; Luke 1:78 ("ንጋት", the dawn) alludes to it but does not quote it.

decisions.choice: धार्मिकता का सूर्य at every level; पंखों में चंगाई (L, B), किरणें (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase "the sun of righteousness" is kept at every level, as the English keeps it, because the picture is the point (m1, m3). Literal and Balanced keep the wings; Readable says rays (m2).

decisions.choice: "солнце праведности", lowercase, at every level
decisions.reason: The phrase is kept at every level, as in the English, with the style guide's "праведность"; it is lowercase because the text speaks of righteousness rising like the sun (m1), and later Christian reading is left to the meaning decision (m3).

decisions.choice: shemesh tsedaqah "義の太陽" at every level (tsedaqah 義 for God's saving righteousness); marpe' "癒やし" (L, B), "いやし" (R); R "その光" for "its wings" as the English R.
decisions.reason: The fixed phrase is kept as one wording at every level, as the English.

source.text: וְעַסּוֹתֶ֣ם רְשָׁעִ֔ים כִּֽי־יִהְי֣וּ אֵ֔פֶר תַּ֖חַת כַּפּ֣וֹת רַגְלֵיכֶ֑ם בַּיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲנִ֣י עֹשֶׂ֔ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And you will tread down [the] wicked, for they will be ashes under [the] soles of your feet, on the day when I act, says Yahweh of hosts.

en.L: And you will tread down the wicked, \q for they will become ashes \q under the soles of your feet, \q on the day when I act, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts.
en.B: You will trample on the wicked; \q they will be ashes \q beneath your feet \q on the day when I act, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: You will walk over the wicked as if they were ashes \q under your feet. \q This will happen on the day when I act, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

fr.L: Et vous foulerez les méchants, \q car ils seront de la cendre \q sous la plante de vos pieds, \q au jour où j’agirai, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.B: Vous piétinerez les méchants ; \q ils seront comme de la cendre \q sous vos pieds \q au jour où j’agirai, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Vous marcherez sur les méchants comme sur de la cendre \q sous vos pieds. \q Cela arrivera au jour où j’agirai, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:pisotearán|pisotearéis}} a los malvados, \q porque ellos serán ceniza \q bajo las plantas de {{plural_you:sus pies|vuestros pies}}, \q en el día en que yo actúe, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos.
es.B: {{plural_you:Pisotearán|Pisotearéis}} a los malvados; \q serán ceniza \q bajo {{plural_you:sus pies|vuestros pies}} \q en el día en que yo actúe, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: {{plural_you:Caminarán|Caminaréis}} sobre los malvados como si fueran ceniza \q bajo {{plural_you:sus pies|vuestros pies}}. \q Esto sucederá en el día en que yo actúe, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

vi.L: Các ngươi sẽ giày đạp kẻ ác, \q vì chúng sẽ thành tro bụi \q dưới lòng bàn chân các ngươi, \q trong ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hành động, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán.
vi.B: Các ngươi sẽ giày đạp kẻ ác; \q chúng sẽ như tro bụi \q dưới chân các ngươi \q trong ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hành động, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán.
vi.R: Các ngươi sẽ bước đi trên kẻ ác như bước trên tro bụi \q dưới chân mình. \q Việc ấy sẽ xảy ra trong ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hành động, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán.

sw.L: Nanyi mtawakanyaga waovu, \q kwa maana watakuwa majivu \q chini ya nyayo za miguu yenu, \q katika siku ile nitakapotenda, \q asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.B: Mtawakanyaga waovu; \q watakuwa majivu \q chini ya miguu yenu \q katika siku ile nitakapotenda, \q asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.R: Mtawakanyaga waovu kana kwamba ni majivu \q chini ya miguu yenu. \q Hili litatokea siku ile nitakapotenda, \q anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.

ko.L: 너희가 악인들을 짓밟을 것이니, \q 그들이 재가 되어 \q 너희 발바닥 아래에 있을 것이다. \q 내가 일하는 그날에 [그렇게 될 것이다]. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.B: 너희가 악인들을 짓밟을 것이다. \q 그들은 재가 되어 \q 너희 발밑에 깔릴 것이다. \q 내가 일하는 그날에 그렇게 될 것이다. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 너희는 악한 사람들을 재처럼 \q 발로 밟고 다닐 것이다. \q 내가 일하는 그날에 그렇게 될 것이다. \q 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: E vocês pisarão os ímpios, \q pois eles se tornarão cinza \q sob as plantas dos pés de vocês, \q no dia em que eu agir, \q diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.B: Vocês pisotearão os ímpios; \q eles serão cinza \q debaixo dos pés de vocês \q no dia em que eu agir, \q diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.R: Vocês vão pisar nos maus como se eles fossem cinza \q debaixo dos seus pés. \q Isso vai acontecer no dia em que eu agir, \q diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.

am.L: ክፉዎችንም ትረግጣላችሁ፤ \q አመድ ይሆናሉና \q ከእግራችሁ መዳፍ በታች፣ \q በማደርግበት ቀን፣ \q ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት።
am.B: ክፉዎችን ትረግጣላችሁ፤ \q አመድ ይሆናሉ \q ከእግራችሁ በታች፣ \q በማደርግበት ቀን፣ \q ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: ክፉዎችን እንደ አመድ ትረግጣላችሁ፤ \q ከእግራችሁ በታች ይሆናሉ። \q ይህም በማደርግበት ቀን ይሆናል፣ \q ይላል የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: और तुम दुष्टों को रौंदोगे, \q क्योंकि वे राख बन जाएँगे \q तुम्हारे पाँवों के तलवों तले, \q उस दिन जब मैं काम करूँगा, \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।
hi.B: तुम दुष्टों को रौंद डालोगे; \q वे राख होंगे \q तुम्हारे पाँवों तले, \q उस दिन जब मैं काम करूँगा, \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।
hi.R: तुम दुष्टों पर ऐसे चलोगे जैसे वे राख हों \q तुम्हारे पैरों के नीचे। \q यह उस दिन होगा जब मैं काम करूँगा, \q सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: И вы будете попирать нечестивых, \q потому что они станут пеплом \q под подошвами ваших ног \q в день, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду действовать, \q — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф.
ru.B: Вы растопчете нечестивых; \q они станут пеплом \q под вашими ногами \q в день, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду действовать, \q — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф.
ru.R: Вы будете ходить по злым людям, как по пеплу \q у вас под ногами. \q Это случится в тот день, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду действовать, \q — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств.

ja.L: あなたがたは悪しき者たちを踏みつける。 \q 彼らは灰となるからだ。 \q あなたがたの足の裏の下で。 \q わたしが行動する日に、 \q と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。
ja.B: あなたがたは悪しき者たちを踏みつける。 \q 彼らは灰となって、 \q あなたがたの足の下にある。 \q わたしが行動するその日に、 \q と万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。
ja.R: あなたたちは、悪い人々の上を歩く。彼らは灰のように、 \q あなたたちの足の下にある。 \q それは、わたしが行動する日に起こる、 \q と天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。

uk.L: І ви топтатимете нечестивих, \q бо вони стануть попелом \q під підошвами ваших ніг \q у день, коли {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} діятиму, \q говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Саваот.
uk.B: Ви топтатимете нечестивих; \q вони будуть попелом \q під вашими ногами \q у день, коли {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} діятиму, \q говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Небесних Військ.
uk.R: Ви ходитимете по нечестивих, ніби вони попіл \q під вашими ногами. \q Це станеться в день, коли {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} діятиму, \q каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} Вседержитель.

decisions.choice: ashes: the remains of the burning of verse 19
decisions.reason: The wicked burned like stubble on the day of verse 19 are left as ashes, and the righteous walk over them. |

decisions.choice: on the day when I act: the day of verse 17
decisions.reason: The same phrase is used in verse 17. |

source.text: זִכְר֕וּ תּוֹרַ֖ת מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדִּ֑י אֲשֶׁר֩ צִוִּ֨יתִי אוֹת֤וֹ בְחֹרֵב֙ עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל חֻקִּ֖ים וּמִשְׁפָּטִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Remember [the] instruction of Moses my servant, which I commanded him at Horeb for all Israel, statutes and judgments.

en.L: Remember the law of Moses {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant, \q which I commanded him at Horeb for all Israel, \q statutes and judgments.
en.B: Remember the law of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Moses, \q the statutes and rulings I commanded him at Horeb for all Israel.
en.R: Remember the law of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Moses. \q I gave him those laws and rules at Mount Horeb for all the people of Israel.

fr.L: Souvenez-vous de la Loi de Moïse, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, \q que je lui ai prescrite à Horeb pour tout Israël : \q prescriptions et jugements.
fr.B: Souvenez-vous de la Loi de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur Moïse, \q des prescriptions et des ordonnances que je lui ai données à Horeb pour tout Israël.
fr.R: Souvenez-vous de la Loi de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur Moïse. \q Je lui ai donné ces lois et ces règles sur le mont Horeb pour tout le peuple d’Israël.

es.L: {{plural_you:Acuérdense|Acordaos}} de la ley de Moisés, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo, \q que le ordené en Horeb para todo Israel, \q estatutos y decretos.
es.B: {{plural_you:Acuérdense|Acordaos}} de la ley de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo Moisés, \q de los estatutos y normas que le ordené en Horeb para todo Israel.
es.R: {{plural_you:Recuerden|Recordad}} la ley de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo Moisés. \q En el monte Horeb le di esas leyes y normas para todo el pueblo de Israel.

vi.L: Hãy nhớ luật pháp của Môi-se, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q là điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho người tại Hô-rếp cho cả Y-sơ-ra-ên, \q [tức là] các luật lệ và mạng lệnh.
vi.B: Hãy nhớ luật pháp của Môi-se, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q tức là các luật lệ và mạng lệnh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho người tại Hô-rếp cho cả Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Hãy nhớ luật pháp của Môi-se, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Tại núi Hô-rếp, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho người các luật lệ và quy định ấy cho toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.

sw.L: Kumbukeni sheria ya Musa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q niliyomwamuru huko Horebu kwa ajili ya Israeli wote, \q kanuni na hukumu.
sw.B: Kumbukeni sheria ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Musa, \q kanuni na maagizo niliyompa huko Horebu kwa ajili ya Israeli wote.
sw.R: Kumbukeni sheria ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Musa. \q Nilimpa sheria hizo na kanuni hizo kwenye mlima Horebu kwa ajili ya watu wote wa Israeli.

ko.L: 내 종 모세의 율법을 기억하여라. \q 그것은 내가 호렙에서 온 이스라엘을 위하여 그에게 명령한 \q 규례와 법도이다.
ko.B: 내 종 모세의 율법을 기억하여라. \q 그것은 내가 호렙에서 온 이스라엘을 위하여 그에게 명령한 규례와 법도이다.
ko.R: 내 종 모세의 율법을 기억하여라. \q 나는 호렙 산에서 온 이스라엘 백성을 위하여 그에게 그 법과 규칙들을 주었다.

pt.L: Lembrem-se da Lei de Moisés, {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo, \q que eu lhe ordenei em Horebe para todo o Israel, \q estatutos e ordenanças.
pt.B: Lembrem-se da Lei do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo Moisés, \q dos estatutos e das ordenanças que eu lhe ordenei em Horebe para todo o Israel.
pt.R: Lembrem-se da Lei do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo Moisés. \q Eu dei a ele essas leis e essas regras no monte Horebe para todo o povo de Israel.

am.L: የባሪያዬን የሙሴን ሕግ አስቡ፤ \q ለእስራኤል ሁሉ በኮሬብ ያዘዝኩትን፣ \q ሥርዓቶችንና ፍርዶችን።
am.B: የአገልጋዬን የሙሴን ሕግ አስቡ፤ \q ለእስራኤል ሁሉ በኮሬብ ያዘዝኩትን ሥርዓቶችንና ደንቦችን።
am.R: የአገልጋዬን የሙሴን ሕግ አስታውሱ። \q ለእስራኤል ሕዝብ ሁሉ በኮሬብ ተራራ እነዚያን ሕጎችና ደንቦች ሰጠሁት።

hi.L: मेरे दास मूसा की व्यवस्था को स्मरण करो, \q जिसकी आज्ञा मैंने होरेब में सारे इस्राएल के लिए उसे दी थी, \q अर्थात् विधियाँ और नियम।
hi.B: मेरे दास मूसा की व्यवस्था को स्मरण करो, \q वे विधियाँ और नियम जिनकी आज्ञा मैंने होरेब में सारे इस्राएल के लिए उसे दी थी।
hi.R: मेरे दास मूसा की व्यवस्था को याद रखो। \q मैंने होरेब पहाड़ पर इस्राएल के सब लोगों के लिए उसे वे विधियाँ और नियम दिए थे।

ru.L: Помните Закон Моисея, {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} раба, \q который {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} заповедал ему на Хориве для всего Израиля, \q установления и правила.
ru.B: Помните Закон {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} раба Моисея, \q установления и правила, которые {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} заповедал ему на Хориве для всего Израиля.
ru.R: Помните Закон {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} раба Моисея. \q Я дал ему эти законы и правила на горе Хорив для всего народа Израиля.

ja.L: わたしのしもべモーセの律法を覚えよ。 \q わたしがホレブで、イスラエル全体のために彼に命じた、 \q 定めと掟を。
ja.B: わたしのしもべモーセの律法を覚えなさい。 \q それは、わたしがホレブで、イスラエル全体のために彼に命じた定めと掟である。
ja.R: わたしのしもべモーセの律法を覚えていなさい。 \q わたしはホレブ山で、イスラエルのすべての民のために、そのきまりとおきてを彼に与えた。

uk.L: Памʼятайте закон Мойсея, {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} раба, \q який {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} заповідав йому на Хориві для всього Ізраїля, \q постанови й правила.
uk.B: Памʼятайте закон {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} раба Мойсея, \q постанови й правила, які {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} заповідав йому на Хориві для всього Ізраїля.
uk.R: Памʼятайте закон {{deity_pronoun:мого|Мого}} раба Мойсея. \q Я дав йому ті закони й правила на горі Хорив для всього народу Ізраїля.

decisions.choice: Horeb: the mountain of God, also called Sinai
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy calls the mountain where the LORD gave the law Horeb (Deuteronomy 4:10; 5:2). |

decisions.choice: remember the law of Moses: the close of the book, and of the Prophets
decisions.reason: The last words of Malachi point back to the law of Moses and forward to the coming of Elijah (verses 23-24). In the Hebrew Bible Malachi closes the Prophets, and these verses join the law and the prophets together. |

decisions.choice: the law of Moses at every level; my servant (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: "The law of Moses" follows Ezra 3:2 for this phrase; elsewhere in the prophets torah is "instruction". "My servant" is kept at every level for the LORD's title for Moses, as the prophets' "my servant" is published (Jeremiah 7:25; 33:21); 2 Kings 21:8 has "slave" at Literal. |

decisions.choice: "la Loi de Moïse", capitalised, at every level; "mon serviteur" at every level
decisions.reason: As the term sheet for the Law of Moses and God's named servants.

decisions.choice: "la ley de Moisés"; "mi siervo" at every level
decisions.reason: The law of Moses is "ley" at every level, as the English "law"; "siervo" follows the term sheet for God's servants. Huqqim and mishpatim are "estatutos y decretos" (L) and "estatutos / leyes y normas" (B, R).

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ Ta" at every level; chuqqim "luật lệ", mishpatim "mạng lệnh" (L, B) / "quy định" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet: God's servants are "đầy tớ" at every level, and statute and rule follow the Pentateuch note.

decisions.choice: "mtumishi wangu" at every level; "sheria ya Musa"
decisions.reason: As the English, which has "servant" at every level for Moses here; "Horebu" is the published form.

decisions.choice: "내 종 모세"; "규례와 법도" (L, B), "법과 규칙" (R)
decisions.reason: Servant is "종" at every level (term sheet); chuqqim and mishpatim follow the Pentateuch wording of the term sheet.

decisions.choice: a Lei de Moisés, capital L (every level); meu servo; Horebe
decisions.reason: Here torah is the Law of Moses itself, as the English says, so Portuguese writes "a Lei" with the capital the style guide gives the Law of Moses (section 5), as Ezra 3:2 does in Portuguese; elsewhere in Malachi torah is "instrução" (2:6-9). "Meu servo" is kept at every level for the LORD's title for Moses, as the English; "Horebe" as the terms list. "Estatutos e ordenanças" follow the terms list for the pair.

decisions.choice: the law of Moses "የሙሴ ሕግ"; my servant "ባሪያዬ" (L), "አገልጋዬ" (B, R); Horeb "ኮሬብ"; statutes and judgments "ሥርዓቶችና ፍርዶች" (L), "ሥርዓቶችና ደንቦች" (B), "ሕጎችና ደንቦች" (R)
decisions.reason: As Deuteronomy 4:5 on main and the settled terms for mishpatim; here torah is the law given at Horeb, so "ሕግ" rather than the "ትምህርት" of 2:6-9.

decisions.choice: मूसा की व्यवस्था; मेरा दास मूसा; विधियाँ और नियम
decisions.reason: "The law of Moses" keeps the wording of Ezra 3:2 for this phrase; elsewhere in the Prophets torah is शिक्षा. "My servant" is मेरा दास at every level, and "statutes and judgments" keep the Pentateuch's pair विधियाँ और नियम (Deuteronomy 4:1). Horeb is होरेब, as Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: "Закон Моисея" with a capital; "Моего раба" at every level; Хорив
decisions.reason: The phrase "the torah of Moses" keeps the form of Ezra 3:2 in Russian, as in the English; elsewhere in the Prophets torah is "наставление". "My servant Moses" as Joshua 1:2; "установления и правила" as Deuteronomy 4:1.

decisions.choice: torat Mosheh "モーセの律法" at every level (the Law, not "教え"); 'avdi "わたしのしもべ" at every level (the English L says "servant"), as Joshua 1:2 and 2 Kings 21:8; chuqqim umishpatim "定めと掟" (L, B), "きまりとおきて" (R) (DEU); Horeb "ホレブ" (L, B), "ホレブ山" (R).
decisions.reason: The law of Moses is the Torah itself; the other forms follow the settled OT notes.

source.text: הִנֵּ֤ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ שֹׁלֵ֣חַ לָכֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת אֵלִיָּ֣ה הַנָּבִ֑יא לִפְנֵ֗י בּ֚וֹא י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה הַגָּד֖וֹל וְהַנּוֹרָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, I [am] sending to you Elijah the prophet before [the] coming of [the] day of Yahweh, the great and the fearful.

en.L: Look, I am sending to you \q Elijah the prophet \q before the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} comes, \q the great and fearful [day].
en.B: See, I am sending you \q Elijah the prophet \q before the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} comes, \q that great and terrible day.
en.R: Look! I am going to send you \q Elijah the prophet \q before the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} comes. \q It will be a great and terrible day.

fr.L: Voici, je vous envoie \q Élie le prophète \q avant que vienne le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q le grand et redoutable [jour].
fr.B: Voici que je vous envoie \q le prophète Élie \q avant que vienne le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q ce jour grand et redoutable.
fr.R: Regardez ! Je vais vous envoyer \q le prophète Élie \q avant que le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} arrive. \q Ce sera un jour grand et terrible.

es.L: He aquí, yo {{plural_you:les|os}} envío \q a Elías el profeta \q antes que venga el día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q el [día] grande y temible.
es.B: Yo {{plural_you:les|os}} envío \q al profeta Elías \q antes que venga el día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q ese día grande y terrible.
es.R: ¡Atención! Voy a enviar{{plural_you:les|os}} \q al profeta Elías \q antes que venga el día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. \q Será un día grande y terrible.

vi.L: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai đến với các ngươi \q Ê-li, nhà tiên tri, \q trước khi ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến, \q [ngày] lớn lao và đáng sợ.
vi.B: Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai đến với các ngươi \q nhà tiên tri Ê-li \q trước khi ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến, \q là ngày lớn lao và đáng sợ.
vi.R: Hãy xem! Ta sẽ sai đến với các ngươi \q nhà tiên tri Ê-li \q trước khi ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến. \q Đó sẽ là một ngày lớn lao và đáng sợ.

sw.L: Tazama, ninawatumia \q Eliya nabii \q kabla ya kuja siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q ile [siku] kuu na ya kutisha.
sw.B: Tazama, nitawatumia \q nabii Eliya \q kabla siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} haijaja, \q siku ile kuu na ya kutisha.
sw.R: Tazama! Nitawatumia \q nabii Eliya \q kabla siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} haijaja. \q Itakuwa siku kuu na ya kutisha.

ko.L: 보라, 내가 너희에게 \q 예언자 엘리야를 보내겠다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날, \q 크고 두려운 [날이] 오기 전에 [보내겠다].
ko.B: 보아라, 내가 너희에게 \q 예언자 엘리야를 보내겠다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날, \q 그 크고 두려운 날이 오기 전에 보내겠다.
ko.R: 보아라! 내가 너희에게 \q 예언자 엘리야를 보내겠다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날이 오기 전에 보내겠다. \q 그날은 크고 무서운 날이 될 것이다.

pt.L: Eis que eu envio a vocês \q o profeta Elias \q antes que venha o dia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q o grande e temível [dia].
pt.B: Vejam, eu estou enviando a vocês \q o profeta Elias \q antes que chegue o dia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q aquele grande e terrível dia.
pt.R: Olhem! Eu vou enviar a vocês \q o profeta Elias \q antes que chegue o dia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. \q Será um dia grande e terrível.

am.L: እነሆ፣ እኔ ወደ እናንተ እልካለሁ \q ነቢዩን ኤልያስን፣ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀን ከመምጣቱ በፊት፣ \q ታላቁና የሚያስፈራው [ቀን]።
am.B: እኔ እልክላችኋለሁ \q ነቢዩን ኤልያስን፣ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀን ከመምጣቱ በፊት፣ \q ያ ታላቅና አስፈሪ ቀን።
am.R: ተመልከቱ! እኔ እልክላችኋለሁ \q ነቢዩን ኤልያስን፣ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቀን ከመምጣቱ በፊት። \q ያ ቀን ታላቅና አስፈሪ ይሆናል።

hi.L: देखो, मैं तुम्हारे पास \q एलिय्याह भविष्यद्वक्ता को भेजूँगा, \q इससे पहले कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दिन आए, \q वह महान और भयावना [दिन]।
hi.B: देखो, मैं तुम्हारे पास \q एलिय्याह भविष्यद्वक्ता को भेजूँगा, \q इससे पहले कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दिन आए, \q वह महान और भयानक दिन।
hi.R: देखो! मैं तुम्हारे पास \q एलिय्याह नबी को भेजनेवाला हूँ, \q इससे पहले कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दिन आए। \q वह महान और भयानक दिन होगा।

ru.L: Вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посылаю вам \q Илию пророка \q прежде чем придёт день {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, \q великий и страшный [день].
ru.B: Вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посылаю вам \q пророка Илию \q прежде чем наступит день {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, \q великий и страшный день.
ru.R: Смотрите! Я пошлю вам \q пророка Илию \q прежде чем придёт день {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. \q Это будет великий и страшный день.

ja.L: 見なさい、わたしはあなたがたに遣わす。 \q 預言者エリヤを。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の日が来る前に。 \q 大いなる、恐ろしい[日が]。
ja.B: 見なさい、わたしはあなたがたに \q 預言者エリヤを遣わす。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の日が来る前に。 \q あの大いなる恐ろしい日が。
ja.R: 見なさい！わたしは、あなたたちのところに \q 預言者エリヤを送る。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の日が来る前に。 \q それは、大いなる恐ろしい日だ。

uk.L: Ось {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посилаю вам \q Іллю, пророка, \q перш ніж прийде день {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, \q великий і страшний [день].
uk.B: Ось {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} посилаю вам \q пророка Іллю, \q перш ніж прийде день {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, \q той великий і страшний день.
uk.R: Дивіться! Я пошлю вам \q пророка Іллю, \q перш ніж прийде день {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}. \q Це буде великий і страшний день.

decisions.choice: This verse is 3:23 in the Hebrew text, 4:5 in many other Bibles
decisions.reason: As at 3:19, many Bibles number 3:19-24 as chapter 4, so this verse is their 4:5 and the next their 4:6. Malachi is cited by the Hebrew numbers.

decisions.choice: Elijah the prophet: the prophet taken up to heaven, who will return
decisions.reason: Elijah was taken up to heaven without dying (2 Kings 2:11), and so was expected to come again. In the New Testament the angel says that John the Baptist will go before the Lord "in the spirit and power of Elijah" (Luke 1:17), and Jesus says that Elijah has already come, meaning John (Matthew 11:14; 17:10-13; Mark 9:11-13). |

decisions.choice: the great and fearful day of the LORD
decisions.reason: The day of the LORD is described in the same words in Joel 2:11 and 3:4. See the note on the day of the LORD at Joel 1:15. |

decisions.choice: the wording of Joel 3:4 at each level: fearful (L), terrible (B, R)
decisions.reason: Where Malachi repeats the words of Joel 3:4, each level uses the wording published there: "before the day of the LORD comes, the great and fearful [day]" (L), "that great and terrible day" (B), "It will be a great and terrible day" (R). "Elijah the prophet" is kept at every level. |

decisions.choice: "Élie le prophète" (L), "le prophète Élie" (B, R); the day of the LORD in the words of the published Joel 3:4 at each level
decisions.reason: As the term sheet; French word order puts the title first in Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: the wording of Joel 3:4 in Spanish at each level; "Elías el profeta" (L), "el profeta Elías" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "el [día] grande y temible" (L), "ese día grande y terrible" (B) and "Será un día grande y terrible" (R) reuse the published Joel; Acts 2:20 in Spanish has "glorioso", from the Greek. The meaning decision's footnote gives the other numbering (4:5).

decisions.choice: the last line reuses the published Vietnamese of Joel 3:4 at each level ("ngày lớn lao và đáng sợ"); "Ê-li, nhà tiên tri" (L) / "nhà tiên tri Ê-li" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as Joel 3:4, as the English notes; the term sheet's forms for Elijah.

decisions.choice: "Eliya nabii" (L); "nabii Eliya" (B, R); "siku ile kuu na ya kutisha", as Joel 3:4 at each level
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording; the last two lines reuse the published Swahili of Joel 3:4 at each level, where the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: "예언자 엘리야"; "크고 두려운 날" (L, B), "크고 무서운 날" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet [Matthew 17:11; Luke 1:17] and the Korean of Joel 3:4, which this line shares; Acts 2:20 says "영광스러운" from the Greek.

decisions.choice: the Portuguese of Joel 3:4 at each level: temível (L), terrível (B, R); o profeta Elias
decisions.reason: Where Malachi repeats Joel 3:4 (m3), each level reuses its Portuguese: "antes que venha o dia do SENHOR, o grande e temível [dia]" (L), "antes que chegue o dia do SENHOR, aquele grande e terrível dia" (B), "Será um dia grande e terrível" (R). "Elias" is the Portuguese form the Gospels use (Luke 1:17; Matthew 17:11), and "o profeta Elias" is the order Portuguese gives a title.

decisions.choice: the great and fearful day as Joel 3:4 on main: "ታላቁና የሚያስፈራው [ቀን]" (L), "ያ ታላቅና አስፈሪ ቀን" (B), "ያ ቀን ታላቅና አስፈሪ ይሆናል" (R); Elijah the prophet "ነቢዩ ኤልያስ"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as Joel 3:4 (meaning decision m3), so Joel's Amharic is copied level by level. The New Testament takes up the promise of Elijah (Matthew 11:14; 17:10-11; Mark 9:11-12; Luke 1:17) without quoting this verse's words; "ኤልያስ" and "ነቢዩ ኤልያስ" are the forms of the Amharic Gospels.

decisions.choice: "I am sending" ends the first line and Elijah follows on the second
decisions.reason: The English sets "I am sending to you" and "Elijah the prophet" on two lines. Amharic puts the object before the verb in prose; in these lines the verb comes first and Elijah follows, so that each line keeps its own part of the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "великий і страшний [день]" (L), "той великий і страшний день" (B), "Це буде великий і страшний день" (R), the Ukrainian of Joel 3:4 at each level
decisions.reason: The English repeats Joel's wording here at each level; the Ukrainian does the same.

decisions.choice: एलिय्याह भविष्यद्वक्ता (L, B), एलिय्याह नबी (R); इससे पहले कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का दिन आए; महान और भयावना (L), भयानक (B, R)
decisions.reason: Elijah keeps the form of the Gospels and Kings, and the prophet the style guide's words. "Great" is महान, as in Acts 2:20 and Zephaniah 1:14; "fearful" is from the Hebrew, where Acts 2:20 follows the Greek "glorious" in quoting Joel 3:4. The last two lines are the words of Joel 3:4 (m3), so each level keeps Joel's Hindi: भयावना at Literal (as Joel 2:11), भयानक at Balanced and Readable. This verse is 3:23 in the Hebrew, 4:5 in many Hindi Bibles (m1).

decisions.choice: "день ГОСПОДА, великий и страшный" (L); "прежде чем наступит день ГОСПОДА, великий и страшный день" (B); "Это будет великий и страшный день" (R); "Илия"
decisions.reason: The words repeat Joel 3:4 (2:31), so they take Joel's Russian wording level by level. "День ГОСПОДА" is the prophets note's form; Илия is the name of 1 Kings 17:1 and the Gospels. The verse is 4:5 in many Bibles (m1).

decisions.choice: Elijah the prophet "預言者エリヤ" (MAT 11:14, 17:11); yom YHWH haggadol vehannora' as Joel 3:4 per level: "大いなる、恐ろしい[日が]" (L), "あの大いなる恐ろしい日が" (B), "大いなる恐ろしい日" (R).
decisions.reason: The English marks the echo of Joel; the Japanese of Joel is reused.

source.text: וְהֵשִׁ֤יב לֵב־אָבוֹת֙ עַל־בָּנִ֔ים וְלֵ֥ב בָּנִ֖ים עַל־אֲבוֹתָ֑ם פֶּן־אָב֕וֹא וְהִכֵּיתִ֥י אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ חֵֽרֶם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will turn [the] heart of fathers to sons and [the] heart of sons to their fathers, lest I come and strike the land [with] a ban.

en.L: And he will turn the hearts of fathers to [their] {{gender:children|sons}} \q and the hearts of {{gender:children|sons}} to their fathers, \q lest I come \q and strike the land [with] a ban.
en.B: He will turn the hearts of fathers to their children \q and the hearts of children to their fathers, \q so that I will not come \q and strike the land with total destruction.
en.R: He will bring fathers and their children back together, \q so that their hearts turn to one another. \q Otherwise I will come \q and destroy the land completely.

fr.L: Et il ramènera le cœur des pères vers [leurs] {{gender:enfants|fils}} \q et le cœur des {{gender:enfants|fils}} vers leurs pères, \q de peur que je ne vienne \q et ne frappe le pays d’interdit.
fr.B: Il ramènera le cœur des pères vers leurs enfants \q et le cœur des enfants vers leurs pères, \q afin que je ne vienne pas \q frapper le pays d’une destruction totale.
fr.R: Il réconciliera les pères et leurs enfants, \q pour que leurs cœurs se tournent les uns vers les autres. \q Sinon, je viendrai \q et je détruirai complètement le pays.

es.L: Y él hará volver el corazón de los padres hacia [los] hijos \q y el corazón de los hijos hacia sus padres, \q no sea que yo venga \q y hiera la tierra con anatema.
es.B: Él hará volver el corazón de los padres hacia sus hijos \q y el corazón de los hijos hacia sus padres, \q para que yo no venga \q a herir la tierra con destrucción total.
es.R: Él volverá a unir a los padres con sus hijos, \q para que sus corazones se vuelvan unos hacia otros. \q Si no, vendré \q y destruiré la tierra por completo.

vi.L: Người sẽ làm cho lòng cha quay về với con cái \q và lòng con cái quay về với cha mình, \q kẻo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đến \q mà giáng sự tận diệt trên đất.
vi.B: Người sẽ làm cho lòng cha quay về với con cái \q và lòng con cái quay về với cha, \q để {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không phải đến \q mà đánh phạt đất này bằng sự hủy diệt hoàn toàn.
vi.R: Người sẽ đem cha và con cái trở lại với nhau, \q để lòng họ hướng về nhau. \q Nếu không, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đến \q và hủy diệt hoàn toàn đất này.

sw.L: Naye atairudisha mioyo ya akina baba kwa watoto [wao], \q na mioyo ya watoto kwa baba zao, \q nisije nikaja \q na kuipiga nchi [kwa] maangamizi kamili.
sw.B: Atairudisha mioyo ya akina baba kwa watoto wao, \q na mioyo ya watoto kwa baba zao, \q ili nisije \q na kuipiga nchi kwa maangamizi kamili.
sw.R: Atawapatanisha akina baba na watoto wao, \q ili mioyo yao igeukiane wao kwa wao. \q La sivyo, nitakuja \q na kuiangamiza nchi kabisa.

ko.L: 그가 아버지들의 마음을 자녀들에게로, \q 자녀들의 마음을 그들의 아버지들에게로 돌이킬 것이다. \q 그렇지 않으면 내가 와서 \q 그 땅을 진멸[의 저주로] 칠 것이다.
ko.B: 그가 아버지들의 마음을 자녀들에게로 돌아서게 하고, \q 자녀들의 마음을 아버지들에게로 돌아서게 할 것이다. \q 그래야 내가 가서 \q 그 땅을 완전히 멸하지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 그는 아버지들과 자녀들이 다시 화목하게 할 것이다. \q 그들의 마음이 서로를 향하게 할 것이다. \q 그렇지 않으면 내가 가서 \q 그 땅을 완전히 멸망시킬 것이다.

pt.L: E ele converterá o coração dos pais aos filhos \q e o coração dos filhos aos seus pais, \q para que eu não venha \q e fira a terra [como] coisa consagrada à destruição.
pt.B: Ele converterá o coração dos pais aos filhos \q e o coração dos filhos aos seus pais, \q para que eu não venha \q e fira a terra, consagrando-a à destruição.
pt.R: Ele vai reaproximar os pais e os filhos, \q para que o coração de uns se volte para os outros. \q Senão, eu virei \q e destruirei a terra completamente.

am.L: እርሱም የአባቶችን ልብ ወደ ልጆቻቸው \q የልጆችንም ልብ ወደ አባቶቻቸው ይመልሳል፤ \q እኔ መጥቼ \q ምድሪቱን ለጥፋት ለይቼ እንዳልመታ።
am.B: የአባቶችን ልብ ወደ ልጆቻቸው፣ \q የልጆችንም ልብ ወደ አባቶቻቸው ይመልሳል፤ \q ይህም መጥቼ \q ምድሪቱን ፈጽሜ እንዳላጠፋ ነው።
am.R: አባቶችንና ልጆቻቸውን እንደገና ያቀራርባል፤ \q ልባቸውም እርስ በርሱ ይመለሳል። \q አለበለዚያ እኔ መጥቼ \q ምድሪቱን ፈጽሜ አጠፋታለሁ።

hi.L: और वह पिताओं के मन [उनके] {{gender:बच्चों|पुत्रों}} की ओर \q और {{gender:बच्चों|पुत्रों}} के मन उनके पिताओं की ओर फेरेगा, \q ऐसा न हो कि मैं आकर \q देश को सर्वनाश [के अर्पण] से मारूँ।
hi.B: वह पिताओं के मन उनकी सन्तान की ओर \q और सन्तान के मन उनके पिताओं की ओर फेरेगा, \q ऐसा न हो कि मैं आऊँ \q और देश का सर्वनाश कर दूँ।
hi.R: वह पिताओं और उनके बच्चों को फिर से एक करेगा, \q ताकि उनके मन एक दूसरे की ओर फिरें। \q नहीं तो मैं आऊँगा \q और देश को पूरी तरह नष्ट कर दूँगा।

ru.L: И он обратит сердца отцов к [их] {{gender:детям|сыновьям}} \q и сердца {{gender:детей|сыновей}} к их отцам, \q чтобы {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не пришёл \q и не поразил землю заклятием.
ru.B: Он обратит сердца отцов к их детям \q и сердца детей к их отцам, \q чтобы {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не пришёл \q и не предал землю полному уничтожению.
ru.R: Он помирит отцов с их детьми, \q чтобы их сердца обратились друг к другу. \q Иначе {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} приду \q и полностью уничтожу эту землю.

ja.L: 彼は父たちの心を{{gender:子ら|息子たち}}に、 \q {{gender:子ら|息子たち}}の心を彼らの父たちに向けさせる。 \q わたしが来て、 \q この地を打って、滅ぼし尽くすべきものとしないために。
ja.B: 彼は父たちの心を子どもたちに、 \q 子どもたちの心を父たちに向けさせる。 \q それは、わたしが来て、 \q この地を打ち、滅ぼし尽くすことのないためである。
ja.R: 彼は、父親たちとその子どもたちを、もう一度結びつける。 \q こうして、彼らの心は互いに向き合うようになる。 \q そうでなければ、わたしは来て、 \q この地を完全に滅ぼしてしまう。

uk.L: І він наверне серця батьків до [їхніх] {{gender:дітей|синів}} \q і серця {{gender:дітей|синів}} до їхніх батьків, \q щоб {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не прийшов \q і не вразив землю закляттям.
uk.B: Він наверне серця батьків до їхніх дітей \q і серця дітей до їхніх батьків, \q щоб {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не прийшов \q і не вразив землю повним знищенням.
uk.R: Він знову зблизить батьків і їхніх дітей, \q щоб їхні серця повернулися одне до одного. \q Інакше {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} прийду \q і цілком знищу землю.

decisions.choice: turn the hearts of fathers to children: taken up in Luke 1:17 and Matthew 17:11
decisions.reason: The angel Gabriel says that John will go before the Lord "to turn the hearts of fathers to their children" (Luke 1:17). The Greek translation of this verse says that Elijah "will restore" the heart of father to son, and Jesus' words "Elijah comes and will restore all things" (Matthew 17:11; Mark 9:12) take up that word. |

decisions.choice: turn the hearts: bring about reconciliation
alternatives: turn the hearts of the present generation back to the faith of their ancestors
decisions.reason: The turning may be the healing of families and of the community, torn by the faithlessness of 2:10-16, or the turning of the people back to the faith of their forefathers. Either way, Elijah's work is to bring the people back together, and back to God, before the day comes.

decisions.choice: a ban: total destruction, as of something devoted to God
decisions.reason: The word (cherem) is the one used for the destruction of Jericho and the Canaanite cities, given over wholly to the LORD (Joshua 6:17-18; Deuteronomy 7:2). If the people do not turn, Israel itself will be treated as the Canaanites were. |

decisions.choice: the last verse of the book
decisions.reason: In Christian Bibles this is the last verse of the Old Testament. When Malachi is read in the synagogue, verse 23 is read again after verse 24, so that the reading does not end on a word of destruction. |

decisions.choice: children (L, gender default; B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means sons, but here it stands for children, as in Luke 1:17, so Literal uses the gender setting and Balanced and Readable say "children". "Fathers" is kept. Readable says "bring fathers and their children back together", as Luke 1:17 does at Readable. |

decisions.choice: "il ramènera le cœur des pères vers ..." (L, B), "il réconciliera" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb of the published Luke 1:17, which takes up this verse, as the term sheet asks.

decisions.choice: {{gender:enfants|fils}} (L)
decisions.reason: The same setting as the English Literal; Balanced and Readable say "enfants" plainly, as the English.

decisions.choice: "hará volver el corazón de los padres hacia [los] hijos" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The line keeps the words of Luke 1:17 in Spanish so the allusion can be seen; Spanish "hijos" includes daughters, so the English gender span is not needed.

decisions.choice: "anatema" (L); "destrucción total" (B); "destruiré ... por completo" (R)
decisions.reason: Herem is the ban, worded as in Zechariah 14:11 at L.

decisions.choice: "làm cho lòng cha quay về với con cái", as Luke 1:17; "con cái" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording, shared with Luke 1:17 (and Matthew 17:11's "phục hồi mọi sự") so the allusion is visible; Vietnamese "con cái" already covers sons and daughters.

decisions.choice: "atairudisha mioyo ya akina baba kwa watoto wao", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The words of the published Luke 1:17, as the term sheet. "Watoto" covers sons and daughters, so the English gender setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: "아버지들의 마음을 자녀들에게로 돌아서게 하고" (B); "다시 화목하게 할 것이다" (R)
decisions.reason: Luke 1:17 takes up this line (meaning decision), and the Korean Luke 1:17 B and R wording is reused at those levels; "자녀" covers "children" and "sons", so there is no gender span. Elijah takes no -시-.

decisions.choice: converterá o coração dos pais aos filhos (L, B); reaproximar os pais e os filhos (R); filhos, no gender setting
decisions.reason: Luke 1:17 takes up this line (m1), so each level keeps the Portuguese published there: "converter o coração dos pais aos filhos" (L, and B, where Luke's Balanced has "reconduzir" but the Hebrew's plain "turn" and the second half of the line are better served by the same verb), and "reaproximar os pais e os filhos" (R). "Filhos" already includes daughters, so Portuguese has no gender span where the English Literal has one.

decisions.choice: [como] coisa consagrada à destruição (L); consagrando-a à destruição (B); destruirei a terra completamente (R)
decisions.reason: Cherem is the ban (m3), the word of Jericho and the Canaanite cities, so it takes the Portuguese set for it in Deuteronomy 7:2 and Joshua 6:17: "coisa consagrada à destruição" at Literal, "consagrar à destruição" at Balanced, "destruir completamente" at Readable. The familiar "ferir a terra com maldição" is avoided: it would confuse the ban with the curse (me'erah) of 2:2 and 3:9.

decisions.choice: Luke 1:17: "የአባቶችን ልብ ወደ ልጆቻቸው … ይመልሳል" (L, B) and "አባቶችንና ልጆቻቸውን እንደገና ያቀራርባል" (R), as the Amharic of Luke; the verb "ይመልሳል" as Matthew 17:11 ("ሁሉንም ነገር ይመልሳል")
decisions.reason: Luke 1:17 takes up the first half of the verse, and the Hebrew agrees with its Greek, so Luke's Amharic is kept at each level; the second half ("the hearts of children to their fathers") is drafted from the Hebrew in the same shape. Matthew 17:11 ("he will restore all things") echoes the Greek translation of this verse, so its verb is kept (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: no gender span on "ልጆች"; the ban (ḥerem) "ለጥፋት ለይቼ" (L), "ፈጽሜ … ማጥፋት" (B, R)
